  69 | function getProductDrawingPreviewUrl(slug: string, configuredUrl?: string) {
  70 |   const normalizedConfiguredUrl = configuredUrl?.trim();
  71 | 
  72 |   if (normalizedConfiguredUrl) {
  73 |     return normalizedConfiguredUrl.includes("#")
  74 |       ? normalizedConfiguredUrl
  75 |       : normalizedConfiguredUrl + "#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1";
  76 |   }
  77 | 
  78 |   const normalizedSlug = slug.trim().toLowerCase();
  79 |   const match = normalizedSlug.match(/^(ea|sm|tm)-(\d+)/);
  80 | 
  81 |   if (!match) {
  82 |     return "";
  83 |   }
  84 | 
  85 |   const seriesCode = match[1];
  86 |   const seriesUpper = seriesCode.toUpperCase();
  87 |   const capacityCode = String(Number(match[2])).padStart(4, "0") + "UL";
  88 | 
  89 |   return (
  90 |     "/assets/products/" +
  91 |     seriesCode +
  92 |     "/2d-drawings/" +
  93 |     seriesUpper +
  94 |     "-" +
  95 |     capacityCode +
  96 |     ".pdf#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1"
  97 |   );
  98 | }
  99 |

 104 | }

 151 | function isFittingDetailData(data: any): boolean {
 152 |   const categoryText = [
 153 |     data?.sourceType,
 154 |     data?.productCategory,
 155 |     data?.productType,
 156 |     data?.productTypeId,
 157 |     data?.productTypeName,
 158 |     data?.category,
 159 |     data?.categoryId,
 160 |     data?.categoryKey,
 161 |     data?.series,
 162 |     data?.seriesName,
 163 |     data?.detailMode,
 164 |     data?.slug,
 165 |     data?.href,
 166 |     data?.detailHref,
 167 |   ]
 168 |     .map((value) =>
 169 |       String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase()
 170 |     )
 171 |     .filter(Boolean)
 172 |     .join(" ");
 173 | 
 174 |   const model = String(
 175 |     data?.model ||
 176 |       data?.displayModel ||
 177 |       data?.modelDisplay ||
 178 |       data?.foreachModel ||
 179 |       ""
 180 |   )
 181 |     .trim()
 182 |     .toUpperCase();
 183 | 
 184 |   return (
 185 |     categoryText.includes("fitting") ||
 186 |     categoryText.includes("connector") ||
 187 |     categoryText.includes("quick-connect") ||
 188 |     categoryText.includes("hard-tube") ||
 189 |     categoryText.includes("luer") ||
 190 |     categoryText.includes("barbed") ||
 191 |     categoryText.includes("thread-to-barbed") ||
 192 |     categoryText.includes("female-thread-adapter") ||
 193 |     categoryText.includes("bulkhead-barbed") ||
 194 |     categoryText.includes("check-valve") ||
 195 |     categoryText.includes("filter") ||
 196 |     /^(Q20|Q40|Q60)/.test(model)
 197 |   );
 198 | }

 681 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 682 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 683 | 
 684 |   if (
 685 |     !isEnglish ||
 686 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 687 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 688 |     href === "/en" ||
 689 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 690 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 691 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 692 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 693 |   ) {
 694 |     return href;
 695 |   }
 696 | 
 697 |   return `/en${href}`;
 698 | }

 735 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 736 | 
 737 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 738 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 739 | 
 740 |   if (!text) {
 741 |     return "";
 742 |   }
 743 | 
 744 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 745 |     return text;
 746 |   }
 747 | 
 748 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 749 | }

 751 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 752 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 753 |     data.mainImage,
 754 |     data.imageUrl,
 755 |     data.image,
 756 |     data.heroImage,
 757 |     data.coverImage,
 758 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 759 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 760 |   ];
 761 | 
 762 |   const urls = values
 763 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 764 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 765 |         return [value];
 766 |       }
 767 | 
 768 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 769 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 770 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 771 |       }
 772 | 
 773 |       return [];
 774 |     })
 775 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 776 |     .filter(Boolean);
 777 | 
 778 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 779 | }
 780 | 
 781 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 782 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 783 |     ? data.specs
 784 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 785 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 786 |       : [];
 787 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 788 | 
 789 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 790 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 791 |       value.forEach(visit);
 792 |       return;
 793 |     }
 794 | 
 795 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 796 |       return;
 797 |     }
 798 | 
 799 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 800 |     const name = String(
 801 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 802 |     ).trim();
 803 |     const itemValue = String(
 804 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 805 |     ).trim();
 806 | 
 807 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 808 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 809 |     }
 810 | 
 811 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 812 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 813 |         visit(child);
 814 |       }
 815 |     });
 816 |   }
 817 | 
 818 |   visit(source);
 819 | 
 820 |   return Array.from(
 821 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 822 |   );
 823 | }

 825 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 826 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 827 |   const productName = String(
 828 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 829 |   ).trim();
 830 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 831 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 832 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 833 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 834 |     : [];
 835 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 836 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 837 |     ? data.faqs
 838 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 839 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 840 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 841 |         }))
 842 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 843 |           item.question && item.answer
 844 |         )
 845 |     : [];
 846 |   const category = String(
 847 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 848 |   ).trim();
 849 | 
 850 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 851 |     "@type": "Product",
 852 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 853 |     name: productName,
 854 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 855 |     description,
 856 |     brand: {
 857 |       "@type": "Brand",
 858 |       name: "FOREACH",
 859 |     },
 860 |     manufacturer: {
 861 |       "@type": "Organization",
 862 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 863 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 864 |     },
 865 |   };
 866 | 
 867 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 868 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 869 |   }
 870 | 
 871 |   if (category) {
 872 |     product.category = category;
 873 |   }
 874 | 
 875 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 876 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 877 |   }
 878 | 
 879 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 880 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 881 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 882 |       name: item.name,
 883 |       value: item.value,
 884 |     }));
 885 |   }
 886 | 
 887 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 888 |     product,
 889 |     {
 890 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 891 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 892 |       itemListElement: [
 893 |         {
 894 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 895 |           position: 1,
 896 |           name: "Home",
 897 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 898 |         },
 899 |         {
 900 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 901 |           position: 2,
 902 |           name: "Products",
 903 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 904 |         },
 905 |         {
 906 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 907 |           position: 3,
 908 |           name: productName,
 909 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 910 |         },
 911 |       ],
 912 |     },
 913 |   ];
 914 | 
 915 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 916 |     graph.push({
 917 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 918 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 919 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 920 |         "@type": "Question",
 921 |         name: item.question,
 922 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 923 |           "@type": "Answer",
 924 |           text: item.answer,
 925 |         },
 926 |       })),
 927 |     });
 928 |   }
 929 | 
 930 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 931 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 932 |   }
 933 | 
 934 |   return {
 935 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 936 |     "@graph": graph,
 937 |   };
 938 | }

 729 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 735 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 736 |     href === "/en" ||
 737 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 738 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 739 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 740 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 741 |   ) {

 744 | 
 745 |   return `/en${href}`;

 783 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 784 | 
 785 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 786 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 787 | 
 788 |   if (!text) {
 789 |     return "";
 790 |   }
 791 | 
 792 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 793 |     return text;
 794 |   }
 795 | 
 796 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 797 | }
 798 | 
 799 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 800 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 801 |     data.mainImage,
 802 |     data.imageUrl,
 803 |     data.image,
 804 |     data.heroImage,
 805 |     data.coverImage,
 806 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 807 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 808 |   ];
 809 | 
 810 |   const urls = values
 811 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 812 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 813 |         return [value];
 814 |       }
 815 | 
 816 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 817 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 818 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 819 |       }
 820 | 
 821 |       return [];
 822 |     })
 823 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 824 |     .filter(Boolean);
 825 | 
 826 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 827 | }
 828 | 
 829 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 830 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 831 |     ? data.specs
 832 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 833 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 834 |       : [];
 835 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 836 | 
 837 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 838 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 839 |       value.forEach(visit);
 840 |       return;
 841 |     }
 842 | 
 843 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 844 |       return;
 845 |     }
 846 | 
 847 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 848 |     const name = String(
 849 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 850 |     ).trim();
 851 |     const itemValue = String(
 852 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 853 |     ).trim();
 854 | 
 855 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 856 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 857 |     }
 858 | 
 859 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 860 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 861 |         visit(child);
 862 |       }
 863 |     });
 864 |   }
 865 | 
 866 |   visit(source);
 867 | 
 868 |   return Array.from(
 869 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 870 |   );
 871 | }
 872 | 
 873 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 874 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 875 |   const productName = String(
 876 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 877 |   ).trim();
 878 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 879 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 880 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 881 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 882 |     : [];
 883 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 884 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 885 |     ? data.faqs
 886 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 887 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 888 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 889 |         }))
 890 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 891 |           item.question && item.answer
 892 |         )
 893 |     : [];
 894 |   const category = String(
 895 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 896 |   ).trim();
 897 | 
 898 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 899 |     "@type": "Product",
 900 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 901 |     name: productName,
 902 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 903 |     description,
 904 |     brand: {
 905 |       "@type": "Brand",
 906 |       name: "FOREACH",
 907 |     },
 908 |     manufacturer: {
 909 |       "@type": "Organization",
 910 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 911 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 912 |     },
 913 |   };
 914 | 
 915 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 916 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 917 |   }
 918 | 
 919 |   if (category) {
 920 |     product.category = category;
 921 |   }
 922 | 
 923 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 924 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 925 |   }
 926 | 
 927 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 928 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 929 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 930 |       name: item.name,
 931 |       value: item.value,
 932 |     }));
 933 |   }
 934 | 
 935 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 936 |     product,
 937 |     {
 938 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 939 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 940 |       itemListElement: [
 941 |         {
 942 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 943 |           position: 1,
 944 |           name: "Home",
 945 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 946 |         },
 947 |         {
 948 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 949 |           position: 2,
 950 |           name: "Products",
 951 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 952 |         },
 953 |         {
 954 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 955 |           position: 3,
 956 |           name: productName,
 957 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 958 |         },
 959 |       ],
 960 |     },
 961 |   ];
 962 | 
 963 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 964 |     graph.push({
 965 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 966 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 967 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 968 |         "@type": "Question",
 969 |         name: item.question,
 970 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 971 |           "@type": "Answer",
 972 |           text: item.answer,
 973 |         },
 974 |       })),
 975 |     });
 976 |   }
 977 | 
 978 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 979 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 980 |   }
 981 | 
 982 |   return {
 983 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 984 |     "@graph": graph,
 985 |   };
 986 | }

 729 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 783 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 784 | 
 785 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 786 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 787 | 
 788 |   if (!text) {
 789 |     return "";
 790 |   }
 791 | 
 792 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 793 |     return text;
 794 |   }
 795 | 
 796 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 797 | }
 798 | 
 799 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 800 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 801 |     data.mainImage,
 802 |     data.imageUrl,
 803 |     data.image,
 804 |     data.heroImage,
 805 |     data.coverImage,
 806 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 807 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 808 |   ];
 809 | 
 810 |   const urls = values
 811 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 812 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 813 |         return [value];
 814 |       }
 815 | 
 816 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 817 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 818 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 819 |       }
 820 | 
 821 |       return [];
 822 |     })
 823 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 824 |     .filter(Boolean);
 825 | 
 826 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 827 | }
 828 | 
 829 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 830 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 831 |     ? data.specs
 832 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 833 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 834 |       : [];
 835 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 836 | 
 837 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 838 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 839 |       value.forEach(visit);
 840 |       return;
 841 |     }
 842 | 
 843 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 844 |       return;
 845 |     }
 846 | 
 847 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 848 |     const name = String(
 849 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 850 |     ).trim();
 851 |     const itemValue = String(
 852 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 853 |     ).trim();
 854 | 
 855 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 856 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 857 |     }
 858 | 
 859 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 860 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 861 |         visit(child);
 862 |       }
 863 |     });
 864 |   }
 865 | 
 866 |   visit(source);
 867 | 
 868 |   return Array.from(
 869 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 870 |   );
 871 | }

 873 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 874 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 875 |   const productName = String(
 876 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 877 |   ).trim();
 878 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 879 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 880 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 881 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 882 |     : [];
 883 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 884 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 885 |     ? data.faqs
 886 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 887 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 888 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 889 |         }))
 890 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 891 |           item.question && item.answer
 892 |         )
 893 |     : [];
 894 |   const category = String(
 895 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 896 |   ).trim();
 897 | 
 898 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 899 |     "@type": "Product",
 900 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 901 |     name: productName,
 902 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 903 |     description,
 904 |     brand: {
 905 |       "@type": "Brand",
 906 |       name: "FOREACH",
 907 |     },
 908 |     manufacturer: {
 909 |       "@type": "Organization",
 910 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 911 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 912 |     },
 913 |   };
 914 | 
 915 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 916 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 917 |   }
 918 | 
 919 |   if (category) {
 920 |     product.category = category;
 921 |   }
 922 | 
 923 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 924 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 925 |   }
 926 | 
 927 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 928 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 929 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 930 |       name: item.name,
 931 |       value: item.value,
 932 |     }));
 933 |   }
 934 | 
 935 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 936 |     product,
 937 |     {
 938 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 939 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 940 |       itemListElement: [
 941 |         {
 942 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 943 |           position: 1,
 944 |           name: "Home",
 945 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 946 |         },
 947 |         {
 948 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 949 |           position: 2,
 950 |           name: "Products",
 951 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 952 |         },
 953 |         {
 954 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 955 |           position: 3,
 956 |           name: productName,
 957 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 958 |         },
 959 |       ],
 960 |     },
 961 |   ];
 962 | 
 963 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 964 |     graph.push({
 965 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 966 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 967 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 968 |         "@type": "Question",
 969 |         name: item.question,
 970 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 971 |           "@type": "Answer",
 972 |           text: item.answer,
 973 |         },
 974 |       })),
 975 |     });
 976 |   }
 977 | 
 978 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 979 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 980 |   }
 981 | 
 982 |   return {
 983 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 984 |     "@graph": graph,
 985 |   };
 986 | }

 223 | function isFittingDetailData(data: any): boolean {
 224 |   const categoryText = [
 225 |     data?.sourceType,
 226 |     data?.productCategory,
 227 |     data?.productType,
 228 |     data?.productTypeId,
 229 |     data?.productTypeName,
 230 |     data?.category,
 231 |     data?.categoryId,
 232 |     data?.categoryKey,
 233 |     data?.series,
 234 |     data?.seriesName,
 235 |     data?.detailMode,
 236 |     data?.slug,
 237 |     data?.href,
 238 |     data?.detailHref,
 239 |   ]
 240 |     .map((value) =>
 241 |       String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase()
 242 |     )
 243 |     .filter(Boolean)
 244 |     .join(" ");
 245 | 
 246 |   const model = String(
 247 |     data?.model ||
 248 |       data?.displayModel ||
 249 |       data?.modelDisplay ||
 250 |       data?.foreachModel ||
 251 |       ""
 252 |   )
 253 |     .trim()
 254 |     .toUpperCase();
 255 | 
 256 |   return (
 257 |     categoryText.includes("fitting") ||
 258 |     categoryText.includes("connector") ||
 259 |     categoryText.includes("quick-connect") ||
 260 |     categoryText.includes("hard-tube") ||
 261 |     categoryText.includes("luer") ||
 262 |     categoryText.includes("barbed") ||
 263 |     categoryText.includes("thread-to-barbed") ||
 264 |     categoryText.includes("female-thread-adapter") ||
 265 |     categoryText.includes("bulkhead-barbed") ||
 266 |     categoryText.includes("check-valve") ||
 267 |     categoryText.includes("filter") ||
 268 |     /^(Q20|Q40|Q60)/.test(model)
 269 |   );
 270 | }

 753 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 754 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 755 | 
 756 |   if (
 757 |     !isEnglish ||
 758 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 759 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 760 |     href === "/en" ||
 761 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 762 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 763 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 764 |     href.startsWith("/api/")

 807 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 808 | 
 809 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 810 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 811 | 
 812 |   if (!text) {
 813 |     return "";
 814 |   }
 815 | 
 816 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 817 |     return text;
 818 |   }
 819 | 
 820 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 821 | }
 822 | 
 823 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 824 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 825 |     data.mainImage,
 826 |     data.imageUrl,
 827 |     data.image,
 828 |     data.heroImage,
 829 |     data.coverImage,
 830 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 831 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 832 |   ];
 833 | 
 834 |   const urls = values
 835 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 836 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 837 |         return [value];
 838 |       }
 839 | 
 840 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 841 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 842 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 843 |       }
 844 | 
 845 |       return [];
 846 |     })
 847 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 848 |     .filter(Boolean);
 849 | 
 850 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 851 | }
 852 | 
 853 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 854 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 855 |     ? data.specs
 856 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 857 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 858 |       : [];
 859 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 860 | 
 861 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 862 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 863 |       value.forEach(visit);
 864 |       return;
 865 |     }
 866 | 
 867 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 868 |       return;
 869 |     }
 870 | 
 871 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 872 |     const name = String(
 873 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 874 |     ).trim();
 875 |     const itemValue = String(
 876 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 877 |     ).trim();
 878 | 
 879 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 880 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 881 |     }
 882 | 
 883 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 884 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 885 |         visit(child);
 886 |       }
 887 |     });
 888 |   }
 889 | 
 890 |   visit(source);
 891 | 
 892 |   return Array.from(
 893 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 894 |   );
 895 | }
 896 | 
 897 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 898 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 899 |   const productName = String(
 900 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 901 |   ).trim();
 902 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 903 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 904 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 905 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 906 |     : [];
 907 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 908 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 909 |     ? data.faqs
 910 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 911 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 912 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 913 |         }))
 914 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 915 |           item.question && item.answer
 916 |         )
 917 |     : [];
 918 |   const category = String(
 919 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 920 |   ).trim();
 921 | 
 922 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 923 |     "@type": "Product",
 924 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 925 |     name: productName,
 926 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 927 |     description,
 928 |     brand: {
 929 |       "@type": "Brand",
 930 |       name: "FOREACH",
 931 |     },
 932 |     manufacturer: {
 933 |       "@type": "Organization",
 934 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 935 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 936 |     },
 937 |   };
 938 | 
 939 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 940 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 941 |   }
 942 | 
 943 |   if (category) {
 944 |     product.category = category;
 945 |   }
 946 | 
 947 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 948 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 949 |   }
 950 | 
 951 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 952 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 953 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 954 |       name: item.name,
 955 |       value: item.value,
 956 |     }));
 957 |   }
 958 | 
 959 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 960 |     product,
 961 |     {
 962 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 963 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 964 |       itemListElement: [
 965 |         {
 966 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 967 |           position: 1,
 968 |           name: "Home",
 969 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 970 |         },
 971 |         {
 972 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 973 |           position: 2,
 974 |           name: "Products",
 975 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 976 |         },
 977 |         {
 978 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 979 |           position: 3,
 980 |           name: productName,
 981 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 982 |         },
 983 |       ],
 984 |     },
 985 |   ];
 986 | 
 987 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 988 |     graph.push({
 989 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 990 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 991 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 992 |         "@type": "Question",
 993 |         name: item.question,
 994 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 995 |           "@type": "Answer",
 996 |           text: item.answer,
 997 |         },
 998 |       })),
 999 |     });
1000 |   }
1001 | 
1002 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
1003 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
1004 |   }
1005 | 
1006 |   return {
1007 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
1008 |     "@graph": graph,
1009 |   };
1010 | }

 705 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 706 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 707 | 
 708 |   if (
 709 |     !isEnglish ||
 710 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 711 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 712 |     href === "/en" ||
 713 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 714 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 715 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 716 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 717 |   ) {
 718 |     return href;
 719 |   }
 720 | 
 721 |   return `/en${href}`;
 722 | }

 759 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 760 | 
 761 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 762 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 763 | 
 764 |   if (!text) {
 765 |     return "";
 766 |   }
 767 | 
 768 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 769 |     return text;
 770 |   }
 771 | 
 772 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 773 | }
 774 | 
 775 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 776 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 777 |     data.mainImage,
 778 |     data.imageUrl,
 779 |     data.image,
 780 |     data.heroImage,
 781 |     data.coverImage,
 782 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 783 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 784 |   ];
 785 | 
 786 |   const urls = values
 787 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 788 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 789 |         return [value];
 790 |       }
 791 | 
 792 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 793 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 794 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 795 |       }
 796 | 
 797 |       return [];
 798 |     })
 799 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 800 |     .filter(Boolean);
 801 | 
 802 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 803 | }
 804 | 
 805 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 806 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 807 |     ? data.specs
 808 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 809 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 810 |       : [];
 811 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 812 | 
 813 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 814 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 815 |       value.forEach(visit);
 816 |       return;
 817 |     }
 818 | 
 819 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 820 |       return;
 821 |     }
 822 | 
 823 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 824 |     const name = String(
 825 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 826 |     ).trim();
 827 |     const itemValue = String(
 828 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 829 |     ).trim();
 830 | 
 831 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 832 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 833 |     }
 834 | 
 835 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 836 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 837 |         visit(child);
 838 |       }
 839 |     });
 840 |   }
 841 | 
 842 |   visit(source);
 843 | 
 844 |   return Array.from(
 845 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 846 |   );
 847 | }
 848 | 
 849 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 850 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 851 |   const productName = String(
 852 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 853 |   ).trim();
 854 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 855 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 856 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 857 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 858 |     : [];
 859 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 860 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 861 |     ? data.faqs
 862 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 863 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 864 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 865 |         }))
 866 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 867 |           item.question && item.answer
 868 |         )
 869 |     : [];
 870 |   const category = String(
 871 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 872 |   ).trim();
 873 | 
 874 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 875 |     "@type": "Product",
 876 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 877 |     name: productName,
 878 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 879 |     description,
 880 |     brand: {
 881 |       "@type": "Brand",
 882 |       name: "FOREACH",
 883 |     },
 884 |     manufacturer: {
 885 |       "@type": "Organization",
 886 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 887 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 888 |     },
 889 |   };
 890 | 
 891 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 892 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 893 |   }
 894 | 
 895 |   if (category) {
 896 |     product.category = category;
 897 |   }
 898 | 
 899 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 900 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 901 |   }
 902 | 
 903 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 904 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 905 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 906 |       name: item.name,
 907 |       value: item.value,
 908 |     }));
 909 |   }
 910 | 
 911 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 912 |     product,
 913 |     {
 914 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 915 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 916 |       itemListElement: [
 917 |         {
 918 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 919 |           position: 1,
 920 |           name: "Home",
 921 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 922 |         },
 923 |         {
 924 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 925 |           position: 2,
 926 |           name: "Products",
 927 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 928 |         },
 929 |         {
 930 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 931 |           position: 3,
 932 |           name: productName,
 933 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 934 |         },
 935 |       ],
 936 |     },
 937 |   ];
 938 | 
 939 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 940 |     graph.push({
 941 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 942 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 943 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 944 |         "@type": "Question",
 945 |         name: item.question,
 946 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 947 |           "@type": "Answer",
 948 |           text: item.answer,
 949 |         },
 950 |       })),
 951 |     });
 952 |   }
 953 | 
 954 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 955 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 956 |   }
 957 | 
 958 |   return {
 959 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 960 |     "@graph": graph,
 961 |   };
 962 | }

 654 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 660 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 661 |     href === "/en" ||
 662 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 663 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 664 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 665 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 666 |   ) {
 667 |     return href;
 668 |   }
 669 | 
 670 |   return `/en${href}`;
 671 | }

 708 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 709 | 
 710 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 711 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 712 | 
 713 |   if (!text) {
 714 |     return "";
 715 |   }
 716 | 
 717 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 718 |     return text;
 719 |   }
 720 | 
 721 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 722 | }
 723 | 
 724 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 725 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 726 |     data.mainImage,
 727 |     data.imageUrl,
 728 |     data.image,
 729 |     data.heroImage,
 730 |     data.coverImage,
 731 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 732 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 733 |   ];
 734 | 
 735 |   const urls = values
 736 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 737 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 738 |         return [value];
 739 |       }
 740 | 
 741 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 742 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 743 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 744 |       }
 745 | 
 746 |       return [];
 747 |     })
 748 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 749 |     .filter(Boolean);
 750 | 
 751 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 752 | }
 753 | 
 754 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 755 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 756 |     ? data.specs
 757 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 758 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 759 |       : [];
 760 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 761 | 
 762 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 763 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 764 |       value.forEach(visit);
 765 |       return;
 766 |     }
 767 | 
 768 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 769 |       return;
 770 |     }
 771 | 
 772 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 773 |     const name = String(
 774 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 775 |     ).trim();
 776 |     const itemValue = String(
 777 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 | 
 780 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 781 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 782 |     }
 783 | 
 784 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 785 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 786 |         visit(child);
 787 |       }
 788 |     });
 789 |   }
 790 | 
 791 |   visit(source);
 792 | 
 793 |   return Array.from(
 794 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 795 |   );
 796 | }

 798 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 799 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 800 |   const productName = String(
 801 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 802 |   ).trim();
 803 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 804 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 805 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 806 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 807 |     : [];
 808 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 809 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 810 |     ? data.faqs
 811 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 812 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 813 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 814 |         }))
 815 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 816 |           item.question && item.answer
 817 |         )
 818 |     : [];
 819 |   const category = String(
 820 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 821 |   ).trim();
 822 | 
 823 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 824 |     "@type": "Product",
 825 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 826 |     name: productName,
 827 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 828 |     description,
 829 |     brand: {
 830 |       "@type": "Brand",
 831 |       name: "FOREACH",
 832 |     },
 833 |     manufacturer: {
 834 |       "@type": "Organization",
 835 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 836 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 837 |     },
 838 |   };
 839 | 
 840 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 841 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 842 |   }
 843 | 
 844 |   if (category) {
 845 |     product.category = category;
 846 |   }
 847 | 
 848 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 849 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 850 |   }
 851 | 
 852 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 853 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 854 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 855 |       name: item.name,
 856 |       value: item.value,
 857 |     }));
 858 |   }
 859 | 
 860 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 861 |     product,
 862 |     {
 863 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 864 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 865 |       itemListElement: [
 866 |         {
 867 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 868 |           position: 1,
 869 |           name: "Home",
 870 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 871 |         },
 872 |         {
 873 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 874 |           position: 2,
 875 |           name: "Products",
 876 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 877 |         },
 878 |         {
 879 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 880 |           position: 3,
 881 |           name: productName,
 882 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 883 |         },
 884 |       ],
 885 |     },
 886 |   ];
 887 | 
 888 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 889 |     graph.push({
 890 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 891 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 892 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 893 |         "@type": "Question",
 894 |         name: item.question,
 895 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 896 |           "@type": "Answer",
 897 |           text: item.answer,
 898 |         },
 899 |       })),
 900 |     });
 901 |   }
 902 | 
 903 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 904 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 905 |   }
 906 | 
 907 |   return {
 908 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 909 |     "@graph": graph,
 910 |   };
 911 | }

 622 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 632 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 633 |     href.startsWith("/api/")

 637 | 
 638 |   return `/en${href}`;

 676 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 677 | 
 678 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 679 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 680 | 
 681 |   if (!text) {
 682 |     return "";
 683 |   }
 684 | 
 685 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 686 |     return text;
 687 |   }
 688 | 
 689 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 690 | }
 691 | 
 692 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 693 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 694 |     data.mainImage,
 695 |     data.imageUrl,
 696 |     data.image,
 697 |     data.heroImage,
 698 |     data.coverImage,
 699 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 700 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 701 |   ];
 702 | 
 703 |   const urls = values
 704 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 705 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 706 |         return [value];
 707 |       }
 708 | 
 709 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 710 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 711 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 712 |       }
 713 | 
 714 |       return [];
 715 |     })
 716 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 717 |     .filter(Boolean);
 718 | 
 719 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 720 | }
 721 | 
 722 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 723 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 724 |     ? data.specs
 725 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 726 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 727 |       : [];
 728 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 729 | 
 730 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 731 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 732 |       value.forEach(visit);
 733 |       return;
 734 |     }
 735 | 
 736 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 737 |       return;
 738 |     }
 739 | 
 740 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 741 |     const name = String(
 742 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 743 |     ).trim();
 744 |     const itemValue = String(
 745 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 746 |     ).trim();
 747 | 
 748 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 749 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 750 |     }
 751 | 
 752 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 753 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 754 |         visit(child);
 755 |       }
 756 |     });
 757 |   }
 758 | 
 759 |   visit(source);
 760 | 
 761 |   return Array.from(
 762 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 763 |   );
 764 | }

 766 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 767 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 768 |   const productName = String(
 769 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 770 |   ).trim();
 771 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 772 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 773 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 774 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 775 |     : [];
 776 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 777 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 778 |     ? data.faqs
 779 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 780 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 781 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 782 |         }))
 783 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 784 |           item.question && item.answer
 785 |         )
 786 |     : [];
 787 |   const category = String(
 788 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 789 |   ).trim();
 790 | 
 791 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 792 |     "@type": "Product",
 793 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 794 |     name: productName,
 795 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 796 |     description,
 797 |     brand: {
 798 |       "@type": "Brand",
 799 |       name: "FOREACH",
 800 |     },
 801 |     manufacturer: {
 802 |       "@type": "Organization",
 803 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 804 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 805 |     },
 806 |   };
 807 | 
 808 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 809 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 810 |   }
 811 | 
 812 |   if (category) {
 813 |     product.category = category;
 814 |   }
 815 | 
 816 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 817 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 818 |   }
 819 | 
 820 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 821 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 822 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 823 |       name: item.name,
 824 |       value: item.value,
 825 |     }));
 826 |   }
 827 | 
 828 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 829 |     product,
 830 |     {
 831 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 832 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 833 |       itemListElement: [
 834 |         {
 835 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 836 |           position: 1,
 837 |           name: "Home",
 838 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 839 |         },
 840 |         {
 841 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 842 |           position: 2,
 843 |           name: "Products",
 844 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 845 |         },
 846 |         {
 847 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 848 |           position: 3,
 849 |           name: productName,
 850 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 851 |         },
 852 |       ],
 853 |     },
 854 |   ];
 855 | 
 856 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 857 |     graph.push({
 858 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 859 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 860 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 861 |         "@type": "Question",
 862 |         name: item.question,
 863 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 864 |           "@type": "Answer",
 865 |           text: item.answer,
 866 |         },
 867 |       })),
 868 |     });
 869 |   }
 870 | 
 871 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 872 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 873 |   }
 874 | 
 875 |   return {
 876 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 877 |     "@graph": graph,
 878 |   };
 879 | }

 654 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 658 |     !isEnglish ||

 660 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 661 |     href === "/en" ||
 662 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 663 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 664 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 665 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 666 |   ) {
 667 |     return href;
 668 |   }
 669 | 
 670 |   return `/en${href}`;
 671 | }

 708 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 709 | 
 710 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 711 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 712 | 
 713 |   if (!text) {
 714 |     return "";
 715 |   }
 716 | 
 717 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 718 |     return text;
 719 |   }
 720 | 
 721 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 722 | }
 723 | 
 724 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 725 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 726 |     data.mainImage,
 727 |     data.imageUrl,
 728 |     data.image,
 729 |     data.heroImage,
 730 |     data.coverImage,
 731 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 732 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 733 |   ];
 734 | 
 735 |   const urls = values
 736 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 737 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 738 |         return [value];
 739 |       }
 740 | 
 741 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 742 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 743 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 744 |       }
 745 | 
 746 |       return [];
 747 |     })
 748 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 749 |     .filter(Boolean);
 750 | 
 751 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 752 | }
 753 | 
 754 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 755 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 756 |     ? data.specs
 757 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 758 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 759 |       : [];
 760 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 761 | 
 762 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 763 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 764 |       value.forEach(visit);
 765 |       return;
 766 |     }
 767 | 
 768 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 769 |       return;
 770 |     }
 771 | 
 772 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 773 |     const name = String(
 774 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 775 |     ).trim();
 776 |     const itemValue = String(
 777 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 | 
 780 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 781 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 782 |     }
 783 | 
 784 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 785 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 786 |         visit(child);
 787 |       }
 788 |     });
 789 |   }
 790 | 
 791 |   visit(source);
 792 | 
 793 |   return Array.from(
 794 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 795 |   );
 796 | }

 798 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 799 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 800 |   const productName = String(
 801 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 802 |   ).trim();
 803 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 804 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 805 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 806 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 807 |     : [];
 808 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 809 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 810 |     ? data.faqs
 811 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 812 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 813 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 814 |         }))
 815 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 816 |           item.question && item.answer
 817 |         )
 818 |     : [];
 819 |   const category = String(
 820 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 821 |   ).trim();
 822 | 
 823 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 824 |     "@type": "Product",
 825 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 826 |     name: productName,
 827 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 828 |     description,
 829 |     brand: {
 830 |       "@type": "Brand",
 831 |       name: "FOREACH",
 832 |     },
 833 |     manufacturer: {
 834 |       "@type": "Organization",
 835 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 836 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 837 |     },
 838 |   };
 839 | 
 840 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 841 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 842 |   }
 843 | 
 844 |   if (category) {
 845 |     product.category = category;
 846 |   }
 847 | 
 848 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 849 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 850 |   }
 851 | 
 852 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 853 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 854 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 855 |       name: item.name,
 856 |       value: item.value,
 857 |     }));
 858 |   }
 859 | 
 860 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 861 |     product,
 862 |     {
 863 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 864 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 865 |       itemListElement: [
 866 |         {
 867 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 868 |           position: 1,
 869 |           name: "Home",
 870 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 871 |         },
 872 |         {
 873 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 874 |           position: 2,
 875 |           name: "Products",
 876 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 877 |         },
 878 |         {
 879 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 880 |           position: 3,
 881 |           name: productName,
 882 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 883 |         },
 884 |       ],
 885 |     },
 886 |   ];
 887 | 
 888 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 889 |     graph.push({
 890 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 891 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 892 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 893 |         "@type": "Question",
 894 |         name: item.question,
 895 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 896 |           "@type": "Answer",
 897 |           text: item.answer,
 898 |         },
 899 |       })),
 900 |     });
 901 |   }
 902 | 
 903 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 904 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 905 |   }
 906 | 
 907 |   return {
 908 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 909 |     "@graph": graph,
 910 |   };
 911 | }

 657 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 659 |

 661 |     !isEnglish ||

 663 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 664 |     href === "/en" ||
 665 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 666 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 667 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 668 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 669 |   ) {
 670 |     return href;
 671 |   }
 672 | 
 673 |   return `/en${href}`;
 674 | }

 711 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 712 | 
 713 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 714 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 715 | 
 716 |   if (!text) {
 717 |     return "";
 718 |   }
 719 | 
 720 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 721 |     return text;
 722 |   }
 723 | 
 724 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 725 | }
 726 | 
 727 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 728 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 729 |     data.mainImage,
 730 |     data.imageUrl,
 731 |     data.image,
 732 |     data.heroImage,
 733 |     data.coverImage,
 734 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 735 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 736 |   ];
 737 | 
 738 |   const urls = values
 739 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 740 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 741 |         return [value];
 742 |       }
 743 | 
 744 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 745 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 746 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 747 |       }
 748 | 
 749 |       return [];
 750 |     })
 751 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 752 |     .filter(Boolean);
 753 | 
 754 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 755 | }
 756 | 
 757 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 758 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 759 |     ? data.specs
 760 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 761 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 762 |       : [];
 763 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 764 | 
 765 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 766 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 767 |       value.forEach(visit);
 768 |       return;
 769 |     }
 770 | 
 771 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 772 |       return;
 773 |     }
 774 | 
 775 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 776 |     const name = String(
 777 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 |     const itemValue = String(
 780 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 781 |     ).trim();
 782 | 
 783 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 784 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 785 |     }
 786 | 
 787 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 788 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 789 |         visit(child);
 790 |       }
 791 |     });
 792 |   }
 793 | 
 794 |   visit(source);
 795 | 
 796 |   return Array.from(
 797 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 798 |   );
 799 | }

 801 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 802 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 803 |   const productName = String(
 804 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 805 |   ).trim();
 806 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 807 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 808 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 809 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 810 |     : [];
 811 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 812 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 813 |     ? data.faqs
 814 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 815 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 816 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 817 |         }))
 818 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 819 |           item.question && item.answer
 820 |         )
 821 |     : [];
 822 |   const category = String(
 823 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 824 |   ).trim();
 825 | 
 826 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 827 |     "@type": "Product",
 828 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 829 |     name: productName,
 830 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 831 |     description,
 832 |     brand: {
 833 |       "@type": "Brand",
 834 |       name: "FOREACH",
 835 |     },
 836 |     manufacturer: {
 837 |       "@type": "Organization",
 838 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 839 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 840 |     },
 841 |   };
 842 | 
 843 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 844 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 845 |   }
 846 | 
 847 |   if (category) {
 848 |     product.category = category;
 849 |   }
 850 | 
 851 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 852 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 853 |   }
 854 | 
 855 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 856 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 857 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 858 |       name: item.name,
 859 |       value: item.value,
 860 |     }));
 861 |   }
 862 | 
 863 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 864 |     product,
 865 |     {
 866 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 867 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 868 |       itemListElement: [
 869 |         {
 870 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 871 |           position: 1,
 872 |           name: "Home",
 873 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 874 |         },
 875 |         {
 876 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 877 |           position: 2,
 878 |           name: "Products",
 879 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 880 |         },
 881 |         {
 882 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 883 |           position: 3,
 884 |           name: productName,
 885 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 886 |         },
 887 |       ],
 888 |     },
 889 |   ];
 890 | 
 891 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 892 |     graph.push({
 893 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 894 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 895 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 896 |         "@type": "Question",
 897 |         name: item.question,
 898 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 899 |           "@type": "Answer",
 900 |           text: item.answer,
 901 |         },
 902 |       })),
 903 |     });
 904 |   }
 905 | 
 906 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 907 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 908 |   }
 909 | 
 910 |   return {
 911 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 912 |     "@graph": graph,
 913 |   };
 914 | }

 657 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 659 |

 661 |     !isEnglish ||
 662 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 663 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 664 |     href === "/en" ||
 665 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 666 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 667 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 668 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 669 |   ) {
 670 |     return href;
 671 |   }
 672 | 
 673 |   return `/en${href}`;
 674 | }

 711 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 712 | 
 713 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 714 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 715 | 
 716 |   if (!text) {
 717 |     return "";
 718 |   }
 719 | 
 720 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 721 |     return text;
 722 |   }
 723 | 
 724 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 725 | }
 726 | 
 727 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 728 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 729 |     data.mainImage,
 730 |     data.imageUrl,
 731 |     data.image,
 732 |     data.heroImage,
 733 |     data.coverImage,
 734 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 735 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 736 |   ];
 737 | 
 738 |   const urls = values
 739 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 740 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 741 |         return [value];
 742 |       }
 743 | 
 744 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 745 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 746 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 747 |       }
 748 | 
 749 |       return [];
 750 |     })
 751 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 752 |     .filter(Boolean);
 753 | 
 754 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 755 | }
 756 | 
 757 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 758 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 759 |     ? data.specs
 760 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 761 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 762 |       : [];
 763 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 764 | 
 765 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 766 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 767 |       value.forEach(visit);
 768 |       return;
 769 |     }
 770 | 
 771 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 772 |       return;
 773 |     }
 774 | 
 775 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 776 |     const name = String(
 777 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 |     const itemValue = String(
 780 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 781 |     ).trim();
 782 | 
 783 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 784 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 785 |     }
 786 | 
 787 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 788 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 789 |         visit(child);
 790 |       }
 791 |     });
 792 |   }
 793 | 
 794 |   visit(source);
 795 | 
 796 |   return Array.from(
 797 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 798 |   );
 799 | }

 801 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 802 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 803 |   const productName = String(
 804 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 805 |   ).trim();
 806 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 807 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 808 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 809 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 810 |     : [];
 811 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 812 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 813 |     ? data.faqs
 814 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 815 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 816 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 817 |         }))
 818 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 819 |           item.question && item.answer
 820 |         )
 821 |     : [];
 822 |   const category = String(
 823 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 824 |   ).trim();
 825 | 
 826 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 827 |     "@type": "Product",
 828 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 829 |     name: productName,
 830 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 831 |     description,
 832 |     brand: {
 833 |       "@type": "Brand",
 834 |       name: "FOREACH",
 835 |     },
 836 |     manufacturer: {
 837 |       "@type": "Organization",
 838 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 839 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 840 |     },
 841 |   };
 842 | 
 843 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 844 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 845 |   }
 846 | 
 847 |   if (category) {
 848 |     product.category = category;
 849 |   }
 850 | 
 851 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 852 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 853 |   }
 854 | 
 855 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 856 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 857 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 858 |       name: item.name,
 859 |       value: item.value,
 860 |     }));
 861 |   }
 862 | 
 863 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 864 |     product,
 865 |     {
 866 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 867 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 868 |       itemListElement: [
 869 |         {
 870 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 871 |           position: 1,
 872 |           name: "Home",
 873 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 874 |         },
 875 |         {
 876 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 877 |           position: 2,
 878 |           name: "Products",
 879 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 880 |         },
 881 |         {
 882 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 883 |           position: 3,
 884 |           name: productName,
 885 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 886 |         },
 887 |       ],
 888 |     },
 889 |   ];
 890 | 
 891 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 892 |     graph.push({
 893 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 894 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 895 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 896 |         "@type": "Question",
 897 |         name: item.question,
 898 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 899 |           "@type": "Answer",
 900 |           text: item.answer,
 901 |         },
 902 |       })),
 903 |     });
 904 |   }
 905 | 
 906 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 907 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 908 |   }
 909 | 
 910 |   return {
 911 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 912 |     "@graph": graph,
 913 |   };
 914 | }

 657 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 658 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 659 | 
 660 |   if (
 661 |     !isEnglish ||
 662 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 663 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 664 |     href === "/en" ||
 665 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 666 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 667 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 668 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 669 |   ) {
 670 |     return href;
 671 |   }
 672 | 
 673 |   return `/en${href}`;
 674 | }

 711 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 712 | 
 713 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 714 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 715 | 
 716 |   if (!text) {
 717 |     return "";
 718 |   }
 719 | 
 720 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 721 |     return text;
 722 |   }
 723 | 
 724 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 725 | }
 726 | 
 727 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 728 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 729 |     data.mainImage,
 730 |     data.imageUrl,
 731 |     data.image,
 732 |     data.heroImage,
 733 |     data.coverImage,
 734 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 735 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 736 |   ];
 737 | 
 738 |   const urls = values
 739 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 740 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 741 |         return [value];
 742 |       }
 743 | 
 744 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 745 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 746 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 747 |       }
 748 | 
 749 |       return [];
 750 |     })
 751 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 752 |     .filter(Boolean);
 753 | 
 754 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 755 | }
 756 | 
 757 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 758 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 759 |     ? data.specs
 760 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 761 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 762 |       : [];
 763 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 764 | 
 765 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 766 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 767 |       value.forEach(visit);
 768 |       return;
 769 |     }
 770 | 
 771 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 772 |       return;
 773 |     }
 774 | 
 775 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 776 |     const name = String(
 777 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 |     const itemValue = String(
 780 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 781 |     ).trim();
 782 | 
 783 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 784 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 785 |     }
 786 | 
 787 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 788 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 789 |         visit(child);
 790 |       }
 791 |     });
 792 |   }
 793 | 
 794 |   visit(source);
 795 | 
 796 |   return Array.from(
 797 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 798 |   );
 799 | }

 801 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 802 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 803 |   const productName = String(
 804 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 805 |   ).trim();
 806 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 807 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 808 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 809 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 810 |     : [];
 811 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 812 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 813 |     ? data.faqs
 814 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 815 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 816 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 817 |         }))
 818 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 819 |           item.question && item.answer
 820 |         )
 821 |     : [];
 822 |   const category = String(
 823 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 824 |   ).trim();
 825 | 
 826 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 827 |     "@type": "Product",
 828 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 829 |     name: productName,
 830 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 831 |     description,
 832 |     brand: {
 833 |       "@type": "Brand",
 834 |       name: "FOREACH",
 835 |     },
 836 |     manufacturer: {
 837 |       "@type": "Organization",
 838 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 839 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 840 |     },
 841 |   };
 842 | 
 843 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 844 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 845 |   }
 846 | 
 847 |   if (category) {
 848 |     product.category = category;
 849 |   }
 850 | 
 851 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 852 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 853 |   }
 854 | 
 855 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 856 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 857 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 858 |       name: item.name,
 859 |       value: item.value,
 860 |     }));
 861 |   }
 862 | 
 863 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 864 |     product,
 865 |     {
 866 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 867 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 868 |       itemListElement: [
 869 |         {
 870 |           "@type": "ListItem",

 816 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, localePrefix: string): string {
 817 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 818 | 
 819 |   if (
 820 |     !localePrefix ||
 821 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 822 |     /^\/(?:en|es|fr|ko|ru)(?:\/|$)/.test(href) ||
 823 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 824 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 825 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 826 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 827 |   ) {
 828 |     return href;
 829 |   }
 830 | 
 831 |   return `${localePrefix}${href}`;
 832 | }

 869 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 870 | 
 871 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 872 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 873 | 
 874 |   if (!text) {
 875 |     return "";
 876 |   }
 877 | 
 878 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 879 |     return text;
 880 |   }
 881 | 
 882 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 883 | }
