```tsx
 885 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 886 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 887 |     data.mainImage,
 888 |     data.imageUrl,
 889 |     data.image,
 890 |     data.heroImage,
 891 |     data.coverImage,
 892 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 893 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 894 |   ];
 895 | 
 896 |   const urls = values
 897 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 898 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 899 |         return [value];
 900 |       }
 901 | 
 902 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 903 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 904 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 905 |       }
 906 | 
 907 |       return [];
 908 |     })
 909 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 910 |     .filter(Boolean);
 911 | 
 912 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 913 | }
 914 | 
 915 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 916 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 917 |     ? data.specs
 918 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 919 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 920 |       : [];
 921 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 922 | 
 923 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 924 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 925 |       value.forEach(visit);
 926 |       return;
 927 |     }
 928 | 
 929 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 930 |       return;
 931 |     }
 932 | 
 933 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 934 |     const name = String(
 935 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 936 |     ).trim();
 937 |     const itemValue = String(
 938 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 939 |     ).trim();
 940 | 
 941 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 942 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 943 |     }
 944 | 
 945 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 946 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 947 |         visit(child);
 948 |       }
 949 |     });
 950 |   }
 951 | 
 952 |   visit(source);
 953 | 
 954 |   return Array.from(
 955 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 956 |   );
 957 | }

 959 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 960 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 961 |   const productName = String(
 962 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 963 |   ).trim();
 964 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 965 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 966 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 967 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 968 |     : [];
 969 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 970 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 971 |     ? data.faqs
 972 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 973 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 974 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 975 |         }))
 976 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 977 |           item.question && item.answer
 978 |         )
 979 |     : [];
 980 |   const category = String(
 981 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 982 |   ).trim();
 983 | 
 984 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 985 |     "@type": "Product",
 986 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 987 |     name: productName,
 988 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 989 |     description,
 990 |     brand: {
 991 |       "@type": "Brand",
 992 |       name: "FOREACH",
 993 |     },
 994 |     manufacturer: {
 995 |       "@type": "Organization",
 996 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 997 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 998 |     },
 999 |   };
1000 | 
1001 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
1002 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
1003 |   }
1004 | 
1005 |   if (category) {
1006 |     product.category = category;
1007 |   }
1008 | 
1009 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
1010 |     product.image = imageUrls;
1011 |   }
1012 | 
1013 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
1014 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
1015 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
1016 |       name: item.name,
1017 |       value: item.value,
1018 |     }));
1019 |   }
1020 | 
1021 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
1022 |     product,
1023 |     {
1024 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
1025 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
1026 |       itemListElement: [
1027 |         {
1028 |           "@type": "ListItem",
1029 |           position: 1,
1030 |           name: "Home",
1031 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
1032 |         },
1033 |         {
1034 |           "@type": "ListItem",
1035 |           position: 2,
1036 |           name: "Products",
1037 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
1038 |         },
1039 |         {
1040 |           "@type": "ListItem",
1041 |           position: 3,
1042 |           name: productName,
1043 |           item: canonicalUrl,
1044 |         },
1045 |       ],
1046 |     },
1047 |   ];
1048 | 
1049 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
1050 |     graph.push({
1051 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
1052 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
1053 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
1054 |         "@type": "Question",
1055 |         name: item.question,
1056 |         acceptedAnswer: {
1057 |           "@type": "Answer",
1058 |           text: item.answer,
1059 |         },
1060 |       })),
1061 |     });
1062 |   }
1063 | 
1064 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
1065 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
1066 |   }
1067 | 
1068 |   return {
1069 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
1070 |     "@graph": graph,
1071 |   };
1072 | }
```

```tsx
 151 | function isFittingDetailData(data: any): boolean {
 152 |   const categoryText = [
 153 |     data?.sourceType,
 154 |     data?.productCategory,
 155 |     data?.productType,
 156 |     data?.productTypeId,
 157 |     data?.productTypeName,
 158 |     data?.category,
 159 |     data?.categoryId,
 160 |     data?.categoryKey,
 161 |     data?.series,
 162 |     data?.seriesName,
 163 |     data?.detailMode,
 164 |     data?.slug,
 165 |     data?.href,
 166 |     data?.detailHref,
 167 |   ]
 168 |     .map((value) =>
 169 |       String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase()
 170 |     )
 171 |     .filter(Boolean)
 172 |     .join(" ");
 173 | 
 174 |   const model = String(
 175 |     data?.model ||
 176 |       data?.displayModel ||
 177 |       data?.modelDisplay ||
 178 |       data?.foreachModel ||
 179 |       ""
 180 |   )
 181 |     .trim()
 182 |     .toUpperCase();
 183 |

 186 |     categoryText.includes("connector") ||

 188 |     categoryText.includes("hard-tube") ||
 189 |     categoryText.includes("luer") ||

 192 |     categoryText.includes("female-thread-adapter") ||

 681 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 682 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 683 | 
 684 |   if (
 685 |     !isEnglish ||
 686 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 687 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 688 |     href === "/en" ||
 689 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 690 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 691 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 692 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 693 |   ) {
 694 |     return href;
 695 |   }
 696 | 
 697 |   return `/en${href}`;
 698 | }

 735 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";

 737 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 738 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 739 | 
 740 |   if (!text) {
 741 |     return "";
 742 |   }
 743 | 
 744 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 745 |     return text;
 746 |   }
 747 | 
 748 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 749 | }

 781 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {

 783 |     ? data.specs
 784 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 785 |       ? data.specificationGroups

 787 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 788 | 
 789 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 790 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 791 |       value.forEach(visit);
 792 |       return;
 793 |     }
 794 | 
 795 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 796 |       return;
 797 |     }
 798 | 
 799 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 800 |     const name = String(
 801 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 802 |     ).trim();

 804 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 805 |     ).trim();
 806 | 
 807 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 808 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 809 |     }
 810 | 
 811 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 812 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 813 |         visit(child);
 814 |       }
 815 |     });
 816 |   }
 817 | 
 818 |   visit(source);
 819 | 
 820 |   return Array.from(
 821 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 822 |   );
 823 | }
```

```tsx
 729 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {

 733 |     !isEnglish ||

 735 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 736 |     href === "/en" ||
 737 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 738 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 739 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 740 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 741 |   ) {
 742 |     return href;
 743 |   }
 744 | 
 745 |   return `/en${href}`;
 746 | }

 783 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 784 | 
 785 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 786 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 787 | 
 788 |   if (!text) {
 789 |     return "";
 790 |   }
 791 | 
 792 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 793 |     return text;
 794 |   }
 795 | 
 796 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 797 | }
 798 | 
 799 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 800 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 801 |     data.mainImage,
 802 |     data.imageUrl,
 803 |     data.image,
 804 |     data.heroImage,
 805 |     data.coverImage,
 806 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 807 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 808 |   ];
 809 | 
 810 |   const urls = values
 811 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 812 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 813 |         return [value];
 814 |       }
 815 | 
 816 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 817 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 818 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 819 |       }
 820 | 
 821 |       return [];
 822 |     })
 823 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 824 |     .filter(Boolean);
 825 | 
 826 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 827 | }
 828 | 
 829 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 830 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 831 |     ? data.specs
 832 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 833 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 834 |       : [];
 835 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 836 | 
 837 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 838 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 839 |       value.forEach(visit);
 840 |       return;
 841 |     }
 842 | 
 843 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 844 |       return;
 845 |     }
 846 | 
 847 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 848 |     const name = String(
 849 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 850 |     ).trim();
 851 |     const itemValue = String(
 852 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 853 |     ).trim();
 854 | 
 855 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 856 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 857 |     }
 858 | 
 859 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 860 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 861 |         visit(child);
 862 |       }
 863 |     });
 864 |   }
 865 | 
 866 |   visit(source);
 867 | 
 868 |   return Array.from(
 869 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 870 |   );
 871 | }
 872 | 
 873 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 874 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 875 |   const productName = String(
 876 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 877 |   ).trim();
 878 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 879 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 880 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 881 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 882 |     : [];
 883 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 884 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 885 |     ? data.faqs
 886 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 887 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 888 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 889 |         }))
 890 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 891 |           item.question && item.answer
 892 |         )
 893 |     : [];
 894 |   const category = String(
 895 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 896 |   ).trim();
 897 | 
 898 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 899 |     "@type": "Product",
 900 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 901 |     name: productName,
 902 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 903 |     description,
 904 |     brand: {
 905 |       "@type": "Brand",
 906 |       name: "FOREACH",
 907 |     },
 908 |     manufacturer: {
 909 |       "@type": "Organization",
 910 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 911 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 912 |     },
 913 |   };
 914 | 
 915 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 916 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 917 |   }
 918 | 
 919 |   if (category) {
 920 |     product.category = category;
 921 |   }
 922 | 
 923 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 924 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 925 |   }
 926 | 
 927 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 928 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 929 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 930 |       name: item.name,
 931 |       value: item.value,
 932 |     }));
 933 |   }
 934 | 
 935 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 936 |     product,
 937 |     {
 938 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 939 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 940 |       itemListElement: [
 941 |         {
 942 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 943 |           position: 1,
 944 |           name: "Home",
 945 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 946 |         },
 947 |         {
 948 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 949 |           position: 2,
 950 |           name: "Products",
 951 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 952 |         },
 953 |         {
 954 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 955 |           position: 3,
 956 |           name: productName,
 957 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 958 |         },
 959 |       ],
 960 |     },
 961 |   ];
 962 | 
 963 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 964 |     graph.push({
 965 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 966 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 967 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 968 |         "@type": "Question",
 969 |         name: item.question,
 970 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 971 |           "@type": "Answer",
 972 |           text: item.answer,
 973 |         },
 974 |       })),
 975 |     });
 976 |   }
 977 | 
 978 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 979 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 980 |   }
 981 | 
 982 |   return {
 983 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 984 |     "@graph": graph,
 985 |   };
 986 | }

 988 | export default function ProductDetailClient({
 989 |   data: sourceData,
 990 | }: ProductDetailClientProps) {
 991 |   const pathname = usePathname();
 992 |   const isEnglish = pathname === "/en" || pathname.startsWith("/en/");
 993 |   const data = useMemo(
 994 |     () =>
 995 |       isEnglish
 996 |         ? localizeProductDetailData(sourceData)
 997 |         : sourceData,
 998 |     [isEnglish, sourceData]
 999 |   );
1000 |   const structuredData = useMemo(
1001 |     () =>
1002 |       isEnglish
1003 |         ? buildProductStructuredData(data, pathname || "/")
1004 |         : null,
1005 |     [data, isEnglish, pathname]
1006 |   );
1007 |   const copy = isEnglish
1008 |     ? {
```

```tsx
 785 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 786 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 787 |

 790 |   }
 791 |

 799 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 800 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 801 |     data.mainImage,
 802 |     data.imageUrl,
 803 |     data.image,
 804 |     data.heroImage,
 805 |     data.coverImage,
 806 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 807 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 808 |   ];
 809 | 
 810 |   const urls = values
 811 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 812 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 813 |         return [value];
 814 |       }
 815 | 
 816 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 817 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 818 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 819 |       }
 820 | 
 821 |       return [];
 822 |     })
 823 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 824 |     .filter(Boolean);
 825 | 
 826 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 827 | }
 828 | 
 829 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 830 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 831 |     ? data.specs
 832 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 833 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 834 |       : [];
 835 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 836 | 
 837 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 838 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 839 |       value.forEach(visit);
 840 |       return;
 841 |     }
 842 | 
 843 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 844 |       return;
 845 |     }
 846 | 
 847 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 848 |     const name = String(
 849 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 850 |     ).trim();
 851 |     const itemValue = String(
 852 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 853 |     ).trim();
 854 | 
 855 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 856 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 857 |     }
 858 | 
 859 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 860 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 861 |         visit(child);
 862 |       }
 863 |     });
 864 |   }
 865 | 
 866 |   visit(source);
 867 | 
 868 |   return Array.from(
 869 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 870 |   );
 871 | }

 873 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {

 888 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 889 |         }))
 890 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 891 |           item.question && item.answer
 892 |         )
 893 |     : [];
 894 |   const category = String(
 895 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 896 |   ).trim();
 897 | 
 898 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 899 |     "@type": "Product",
 900 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 901 |     name: productName,

 913 |   };
 914 | 
 915 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {

 917 |   }
 918 | 
 919 |   if (category) {
 920 |     product.category = category;
 921 |   }
 922 | 
 923 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 924 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 925 |   }
 926 | 
 927 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 928 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 929 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 930 |       name: item.name,
 931 |       value: item.value,
 932 |     }));
 933 |   }
 934 | 
 935 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 936 |     product,
 937 |     {
 938 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 939 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 940 |       itemListElement: [

 943 |           position: 1,
 944 |           name: "Home",
 945 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 946 |         },
 947 |         {
 948 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 949 |           position: 2,
 950 |           name: "Products",
 951 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 952 |         },
 953 |         {
 954 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 955 |           position: 3,
 956 |           name: productName,
 957 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 958 |         },
 959 |       ],
 960 |     },
 961 |   ];
 962 | 
 963 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 964 |     graph.push({
 965 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 966 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 967 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({

 974 |       })),
 975 |     });
 976 |   }
 977 | 
 978 |   if (applications.length > 0) {

 980 |   }
 981 | 
 982 |   return {

 985 |   };
```

```tsx
  96 |       : normalizedConfiguredUrl + "#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1";
  97 |   }
  98 | 
  99 |   const normalizedSlug = slug.trim().toLowerCase();
 100 |   const match = normalizedSlug.match(/^(ea|sm|tm)-(\d+)/);
 101 | 
 102 |   if (!match) {
 103 |     return "";
 104 |   }
 105 | 
 106 |   const seriesCode = match[1];
 107 |   const seriesUpper = seriesCode.toUpperCase();
 108 |   const capacityCode = String(Number(match[2])).padStart(4, "0") + "UL";
 109 | 
 110 |   return (
 111 |     "/assets/products/" +
 112 |     seriesCode +
 113 |     "/2d-drawings/" +
 114 |     seriesUpper +
 115 |     "-" +
 116 |     capacityCode +
 117 |     ".pdf#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1"
 118 |   );
 119 | }

 823 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 824 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 825 |     data.mainImage,
 826 |     data.imageUrl,
 827 |     data.image,
 828 |     data.heroImage,
 829 |     data.coverImage,
 830 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 831 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 832 |   ];
 833 | 
 834 |   const urls = values
 835 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 836 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 837 |         return [value];
 838 |       }
 839 | 
 840 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 841 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 842 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 843 |       }
 844 | 
 845 |       return [];
 846 |     })
 847 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 848 |     .filter(Boolean);
 849 | 
 850 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 851 | }

 853 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 854 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 855 |     ? data.specs
 856 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 857 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 858 |       : [];
 859 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 860 | 
 861 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 862 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 863 |       value.forEach(visit);
 864 |       return;
 865 |     }
 866 | 
 867 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 868 |       return;
 869 |     }
 870 | 
 871 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 872 |     const name = String(
 873 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 874 |     ).trim();
 875 |     const itemValue = String(
 876 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 877 |     ).trim();
 878 | 
 879 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 880 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 881 |     }
 882 | 
 883 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 884 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 885 |         visit(child);
 886 |       }
 887 |     });
 888 |   }
 889 | 
 890 |   visit(source);
 891 | 
 892 |   return Array.from(
 893 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 894 |   );
 895 | }

 986 |

1004 |   }
1005 |
```

```tsx
 705 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 706 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 707 | 
 708 |   if (
 709 |     !isEnglish ||
 710 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 711 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 712 |     href === "/en" ||
 713 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 714 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 715 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 716 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 717 |   ) {
 718 |     return href;
 719 |   }
 720 | 
 721 |   return `/en${href}`;
 722 | }

 759 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 760 | 
 761 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 762 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 763 | 
 764 |   if (!text) {
 765 |     return "";
 766 |   }
 767 | 
 768 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 769 |     return text;
 770 |   }
 771 | 
 772 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 773 | }
 774 | 
 775 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 776 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 777 |     data.mainImage,
 778 |     data.imageUrl,
 779 |     data.image,
 780 |     data.heroImage,
 781 |     data.coverImage,
 782 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 783 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 784 |   ];
 785 | 
 786 |   const urls = values
 787 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 788 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 789 |         return [value];
 790 |       }
 791 | 
 792 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 793 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 794 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 795 |       }
 796 | 
 797 |       return [];
 798 |     })
 799 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 800 |     .filter(Boolean);
 801 | 
 802 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 803 | }
 804 | 
 805 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 806 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 807 |     ? data.specs
 808 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 809 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 810 |       : [];
 811 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 812 | 
 813 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 814 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 815 |       value.forEach(visit);
 816 |       return;
 817 |     }
 818 | 
 819 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 820 |       return;
 821 |     }
 822 | 
 823 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 824 |     const name = String(
 825 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 826 |     ).trim();
 827 |     const itemValue = String(
 828 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 829 |     ).trim();
 830 | 
 831 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 832 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 833 |     }
 834 | 
 835 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 836 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 837 |         visit(child);
 838 |       }
 839 |     });
 840 |   }
 841 | 
 842 |   visit(source);
 843 | 
 844 |   return Array.from(
 845 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 846 |   );
 847 | }

 849 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 850 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 851 |   const productName = String(
 852 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 853 |   ).trim();
 854 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 855 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 856 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 857 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 858 |     : [];
 859 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 860 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 861 |     ? data.faqs
 862 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 863 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 864 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 865 |         }))
 866 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 867 |           item.question && item.answer
 868 |         )
 869 |     : [];
 870 |   const category = String(
 871 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 872 |   ).trim();
 873 | 
 874 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 875 |     "@type": "Product",
 876 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 877 |     name: productName,
 878 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 879 |     description,
 880 |     brand: {
 881 |       "@type": "Brand",
 882 |       name: "FOREACH",
 883 |     },
 884 |     manufacturer: {
 885 |       "@type": "Organization",
 886 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 887 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 888 |     },
```

```tsx
 710 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 711 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 712 | 
 713 |   if (!text) {

 715 |   }
 716 | 
 717 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {

 724 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 725 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 726 |     data.mainImage,
 727 |     data.imageUrl,
 728 |     data.image,
 729 |     data.heroImage,
 730 |     data.coverImage,
 731 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 732 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 733 |   ];
 734 | 
 735 |   const urls = values
 736 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 737 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 738 |         return [value];
 739 |       }
 740 | 
 741 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 742 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 743 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 744 |       }
 745 | 
 746 |       return [];
 747 |     })
 748 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 749 |     .filter(Boolean);
 750 | 
 751 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 752 | }

 754 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 755 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 756 |     ? data.specs
 757 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 758 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 759 |       : [];
 760 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 761 | 
 762 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 763 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 764 |       value.forEach(visit);
 765 |       return;
 766 |     }
 767 | 
 768 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 769 |       return;
 770 |     }
 771 | 
 772 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 773 |     const name = String(
 774 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 775 |     ).trim();
 776 |     const itemValue = String(
 777 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 | 
 780 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 781 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 782 |     }
 783 | 
 784 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 785 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 786 |         visit(child);
 787 |       }
 788 |     });
 789 |   }
 790 | 
 791 |   visit(source);
 792 | 
 793 |   return Array.from(
 794 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 795 |   );
 796 | }

 798 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {

 815 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 816 |           item.question && item.answer
 817 |         )
 818 |     : [];
 819 |   const category = String(
 820 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 821 |   ).trim();
 822 | 
 823 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 824 |     "@type": "Product",

 843 | 
 844 |   if (category) {
 845 |     product.category = category;
 846 |   }
 847 | 
 848 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 849 |     product.image = imageUrls;

 851 | 
 852 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 853 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 854 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 855 |       name: item.name,
 856 |       value: item.value,
 857 |     }));
 858 |   }
 859 | 
 860 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 861 |     product,
 862 |     {

 864 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 865 |       itemListElement: [

 875 |           name: "Products",
 876 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 877 |         },
 878 |         {
 879 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 880 |           position: 3,
 881 |           name: productName,
 882 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 883 |         },
 884 |       ],
 885 |     },
 886 |   ];
 887 | 
 888 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 889 |     graph.push({
 890 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 891 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 892 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 893 |         "@type": "Question",

 895 |         acceptedAnswer: {

 898 |         },
 899 |       })),
 900 |     });
 901 |   }
 902 | 
 903 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 904 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 905 |   }
 906 | 
 907 |   return {

 910 |   };
```

```tsx
 622 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 623 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 624 | 
 625 |   if (
 626 |     !isEnglish ||
 627 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 628 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 629 |     href === "/en" ||
 630 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 631 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 632 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 633 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 634 |   ) {
 635 |     return href;
 636 |   }
 637 | 
 638 |   return `/en${href}`;
 639 | }

 676 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 677 | 
 678 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 679 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 680 | 
 681 |   if (!text) {
 682 |     return "";
 683 |   }
 684 | 
 685 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 686 |     return text;
 687 |   }
 688 | 
 689 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 690 | }

 692 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 693 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 694 |     data.mainImage,
 695 |     data.imageUrl,
 696 |     data.image,
 697 |     data.heroImage,
 698 |     data.coverImage,
 699 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 700 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 701 |   ];
 702 | 
 703 |   const urls = values
 704 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 705 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 706 |         return [value];
 707 |       }
 708 | 
 709 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 710 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 711 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 712 |       }
 713 | 
 714 |       return [];
 715 |     })
 716 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 717 |     .filter(Boolean);
 718 | 
 719 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 720 | }

 722 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 723 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 724 |     ? data.specs
 725 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 726 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 727 |       : [];
 728 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 729 | 
 730 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 731 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 732 |       value.forEach(visit);
 733 |       return;
 734 |     }
 735 | 
 736 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 737 |       return;
 738 |     }
 739 | 
 740 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 741 |     const name = String(
 742 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 743 |     ).trim();
 744 |     const itemValue = String(
 745 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 746 |     ).trim();
 747 | 
 748 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 749 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 750 |     }
 751 | 
 752 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 753 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 754 |         visit(child);
 755 |       }
 756 |     });
 757 |   }
 758 | 
 759 |   visit(source);
 760 | 
 761 |   return Array.from(
 762 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 763 |   );
 764 | }
```

```tsx
 708 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";

 710 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 711 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 712 | 
 713 |   if (!text) {
 714 |     return "";
 715 |   }
 716 | 
 717 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 718 |     return text;
 719 |   }
 720 | 
 721 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 722 | }

 724 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 725 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 726 |     data.mainImage,
 727 |     data.imageUrl,
 728 |     data.image,
 729 |     data.heroImage,
 730 |     data.coverImage,
 731 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 732 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 733 |   ];
 734 | 
 735 |   const urls = values
 736 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 737 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 738 |         return [value];
 739 |       }
 740 | 
 741 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 742 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 743 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 744 |       }
 745 | 
 746 |       return [];
 747 |     })
 748 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 749 |     .filter(Boolean);
 750 | 
 751 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 752 | }
 753 | 
 754 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 755 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 756 |     ? data.specs
 757 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 758 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 759 |       : [];
 760 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 761 | 
 762 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 763 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 764 |       value.forEach(visit);
 765 |       return;
 766 |     }
 767 | 
 768 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 769 |       return;
 770 |     }
 771 | 
 772 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 773 |     const name = String(
 774 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 775 |     ).trim();
 776 |     const itemValue = String(
 777 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 | 
 780 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 781 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 782 |     }
 783 | 
 784 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 785 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 786 |         visit(child);
 787 |       }
 788 |     });
 789 |   }
 790 | 
 791 |   visit(source);
 792 | 
 793 |   return Array.from(
 794 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 795 |   );
 796 | }

 798 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 799 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 800 |   const productName = String(
 801 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 802 |   ).trim();
 803 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 804 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 805 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 806 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 807 |     : [];
 808 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 809 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 810 |     ? data.faqs
 811 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 812 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 813 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 814 |         }))
 815 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 816 |           item.question && item.answer
 817 |         )
 818 |     : [];
 819 |   const category = String(
 820 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 821 |   ).trim();
 822 | 
 823 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 824 |     "@type": "Product",
 825 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 826 |     name: productName,
 827 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 828 |     description,
 829 |     brand: {
 830 |       "@type": "Brand",
 831 |       name: "FOREACH",
 832 |     },
 833 |     manufacturer: {
 834 |       "@type": "Organization",
 835 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 836 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 837 |     },
 838 |   };
 839 | 
 840 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 841 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 842 |   }
 843 | 
 844 |   if (category) {
 845 |     product.category = category;
 846 |   }
 847 | 
 848 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 849 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 850 |   }
 851 | 
 852 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 853 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 854 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 855 |       name: item.name,
 856 |       value: item.value,
 857 |     }));
 858 |   }
 859 | 
 860 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 861 |     product,
 862 |     {
 863 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 864 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 865 |       itemListElement: [
 866 |         {
 867 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 868 |           position: 1,
 869 |           name: "Home",
 870 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 871 |         },
 872 |         {
 873 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 874 |           position: 2,
 875 |           name: "Products",
 876 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 877 |         },
 878 |         {
 879 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 880 |           position: 3,
 881 |           name: productName,
 882 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 883 |         },
 884 |       ],
 885 |     },
 886 |   ];
 887 | 
 888 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 889 |     graph.push({
 890 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 891 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 892 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 893 |         "@type": "Question",
 894 |         name: item.question,
 895 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 896 |           "@type": "Answer",
 897 |           text: item.answer,
 898 |         },
 899 |       })),
 900 |     });
 901 |   }
 902 | 
 903 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 904 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 905 |   }
 906 | 
 907 |   return {
 908 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 909 |     "@graph": graph,
 910 |   };
 911 | }
```

```tsx
  62 | function getProductDrawingPreviewUrl(slug: string, configuredUrl?: string) {
  63 |   const normalizedConfiguredUrl = configuredUrl?.trim();
  64 | 
  65 |   if (normalizedConfiguredUrl) {
  66 |     return normalizedConfiguredUrl.includes("#")
  67 |       ? normalizedConfiguredUrl
  68 |       : normalizedConfiguredUrl + "#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1";
  69 |   }
  70 | 
  71 |   const normalizedSlug = slug.trim().toLowerCase();
  72 |   const match = normalizedSlug.match(/^(ea|sm|tm)-(\d+)/);
  73 | 
  74 |   if (!match) {
  75 |     return "";
  76 |   }
  77 | 
  78 |   const seriesCode = match[1];
  79 |   const seriesUpper = seriesCode.toUpperCase();
  80 |   const capacityCode = String(Number(match[2])).padStart(4, "0") + "UL";
  81 | 
  82 |   return (
  83 |     "/assets/products/" +
  84 |     seriesCode +
  85 |     "/2d-drawings/" +
  86 |     seriesUpper +
  87 |     "-" +
  88 |     capacityCode +
  89 |     ".pdf#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1"
  90 |   );
  91 | }
  92 | 
  93 | function isPlungerPumpDisplayModel(value: unknown): boolean {
  94 |   const model = String(value || "").trim();
  95 | 
  96 |   return /^(EA|SM|TM)-/i.test(model);
  97 | }

 127 | function isFittingDetailData(data: any): boolean {
 128 |   const categoryText = [
 129 |     data?.sourceType,
 130 |     data?.productCategory,
 131 |     data?.productType,
 132 |     data?.productTypeId,
 133 |     data?.productTypeName,
 134 |     data?.category,
 135 |     data?.categoryId,
 136 |     data?.categoryKey,
 137 |     data?.series,
 138 |     data?.seriesName,
 139 |     data?.detailMode,
 140 |     data?.slug,
 141 |     data?.href,
 142 |     data?.detailHref,
 143 |   ]
 144 |     .map((value) =>
 145 |       String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase()
 146 |     )
 147 |     .filter(Boolean)
 148 |     .join(" ");
 149 | 
 150 |   const model = String(
 151 |     data?.model ||
 152 |       data?.displayModel ||
 153 |       data?.modelDisplay ||
 154 |       data?.foreachModel ||
 155 |       ""
 156 |   )
 157 |     .trim()
 158 |     .toUpperCase();
 159 | 
 160 |   return (
 161 |     categoryText.includes("fitting") ||
 162 |     categoryText.includes("connector") ||
 163 |     categoryText.includes("quick-connect") ||
 164 |     categoryText.includes("hard-tube") ||
 165 |     categoryText.includes("luer") ||
 166 |     categoryText.includes("barbed") ||
 167 |     categoryText.includes("thread-to-barbed") ||
 168 |     categoryText.includes("female-thread-adapter") ||
 169 |     categoryText.includes("bulkhead-barbed") ||
 170 |     categoryText.includes("check-valve") ||
 171 |     categoryText.includes("filter") ||
 172 |     /^(Q20|Q40|Q60)/.test(model)
 173 |   );
 174 | }

 727 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 728 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 729 |     data.mainImage,
 730 |     data.imageUrl,
 731 |     data.image,
 732 |     data.heroImage,
 733 |     data.coverImage,
 734 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 735 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 736 |   ];
 737 | 
 738 |   const urls = values
 739 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 740 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 741 |         return [value];
 742 |       }
 743 | 
 744 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 745 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 746 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 747 |       }
 748 | 
 749 |       return [];
 750 |     })
 751 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 752 |     .filter(Boolean);
 753 | 
 754 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 755 | }

 757 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 758 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 759 |     ? data.specs
 760 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 761 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 762 |       : [];
 763 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 764 | 
 765 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 766 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 767 |       value.forEach(visit);
 768 |       return;
 769 |     }
 770 | 
 771 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 772 |       return;
 773 |     }
 774 | 
 775 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 776 |     const name = String(
 777 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 |     const itemValue = String(
 780 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 781 |     ).trim();
 782 | 
 783 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 784 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 785 |     }
 786 | 
 787 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 788 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 789 |         visit(child);
 790 |       }
 791 |     });
 792 |   }
 793 | 
 794 |   visit(source);
 795 | 
 796 |   return Array.from(
 797 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 798 |   );
 799 | }
```

```tsx
 657 | function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
 658 |   const href = String(value || "").trim();
 659 | 
 660 |   if (
 661 |     !isEnglish ||
 662 |     !href.startsWith("/") ||
 663 |     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
 664 |     href === "/en" ||
 665 |     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
 666 |     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
 667 |     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
 668 |     href.startsWith("/api/")
 669 |   ) {
 670 |     return href;
 671 |   }
 672 | 
 673 |   return `/en${href}`;
 674 | }

 711 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 712 | 
 713 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 714 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 715 | 
 716 |   if (!text) {
 717 |     return "";
 718 |   }
 719 | 
 720 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 721 |     return text;
 722 |   }
 723 | 
 724 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 725 | }
 726 | 
 727 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 728 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 729 |     data.mainImage,
 730 |     data.imageUrl,
 731 |     data.image,
 732 |     data.heroImage,
 733 |     data.coverImage,
 734 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 735 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 736 |   ];
 737 | 
 738 |   const urls = values
 739 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 740 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 741 |         return [value];
 742 |       }
 743 | 
 744 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 745 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 746 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 747 |       }
 748 | 
 749 |       return [];
 750 |     })
 751 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 752 |     .filter(Boolean);
 753 | 
 754 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 755 | }
 756 | 
 757 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 758 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 759 |     ? data.specs
 760 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 761 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 762 |       : [];
 763 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 764 | 
 765 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 766 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 767 |       value.forEach(visit);
 768 |       return;
 769 |     }
 770 | 
 771 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 772 |       return;
 773 |     }
 774 | 
 775 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 776 |     const name = String(
 777 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 |     const itemValue = String(
 780 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 781 |     ).trim();
 782 | 
 783 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 784 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 785 |     }
 786 | 
 787 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 788 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 789 |         visit(child);
 790 |       }
 791 |     });
 792 |   }
 793 | 
 794 |   visit(source);
 795 | 
 796 |   return Array.from(
 797 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 798 |   );
 799 | }

 801 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 802 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 803 |   const productName = String(
 804 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 805 |   ).trim();
 806 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 807 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 808 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 809 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 810 |     : [];
 811 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 812 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 813 |     ? data.faqs
 814 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 815 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 816 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 817 |         }))
 818 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 819 |           item.question && item.answer
 820 |         )
 821 |     : [];
 822 |   const category = String(
 823 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 824 |   ).trim();
 825 | 
 826 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 827 |     "@type": "Product",
 828 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 829 |     name: productName,
 830 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 831 |     description,
 832 |     brand: {
 833 |       "@type": "Brand",
 834 |       name: "FOREACH",
 835 |     },
 836 |     manufacturer: {
 837 |       "@type": "Organization",
 838 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 839 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 840 |     },
 841 |   };
 842 | 
 843 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 844 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 845 |   }
 846 | 
 847 |   if (category) {
 848 |     product.category = category;
 849 |   }
 850 | 
 851 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 852 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 853 |   }
 854 | 
 855 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 856 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 857 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 858 |       name: item.name,
 859 |       value: item.value,
 860 |     }));
 861 |   }
 862 | 
 863 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 864 |     product,
 865 |     {
 866 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 867 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 868 |       itemListElement: [
 869 |         {
 870 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 871 |           position: 1,
 872 |           name: "Home",
 873 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 874 |         },
 875 |         {
 876 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 877 |           position: 2,
 878 |           name: "Products",
 879 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 880 |         },
 881 |         {
 882 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 883 |           position: 3,
 884 |           name: productName,
 885 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 886 |         },
 887 |       ],
 888 |     },
 889 |   ];
 890 | 
 891 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 892 |     graph.push({
```

```tsx
 711 | const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
 712 | 
 713 | function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
 714 |   const text = String(value || "").trim();
 715 | 
 716 |   if (!text) {
 717 |     return "";
 718 |   }
 719 | 
 720 |   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
 721 |     return text;
 722 |   }
 723 | 
 724 |   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
 725 | }
 726 | 
 727 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 728 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 729 |     data.mainImage,
 730 |     data.imageUrl,
 731 |     data.image,
 732 |     data.heroImage,
 733 |     data.coverImage,
 734 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 735 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 736 |   ];
 737 | 
 738 |   const urls = values
 739 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 740 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 741 |         return [value];
 742 |       }
 743 | 
 744 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 745 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 746 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 747 |       }
 748 | 
 749 |       return [];
 750 |     })
 751 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 752 |     .filter(Boolean);
 753 | 
 754 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 755 | }
 756 | 
 757 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 758 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 759 |     ? data.specs
 760 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 761 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 762 |       : [];
 763 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 764 | 
 765 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 766 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 767 |       value.forEach(visit);
 768 |       return;
 769 |     }
 770 | 
 771 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 772 |       return;
 773 |     }
 774 | 
 775 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 776 |     const name = String(
 777 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 778 |     ).trim();
 779 |     const itemValue = String(
 780 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 781 |     ).trim();
 782 | 
 783 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 784 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 785 |     }
 786 | 
 787 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 788 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 789 |         visit(child);
 790 |       }
 791 |     });
 792 |   }
 793 | 
 794 |   visit(source);
 795 | 
 796 |   return Array.from(
 797 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 798 |   );
 799 | }
 800 | 
 801 | function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
 802 |   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
 803 |   const productName = String(
 804 |     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
 805 |   ).trim();
 806 |   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
 807 |   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
 808 |   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
 809 |     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
 810 |     : [];
 811 |   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
 812 |   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
 813 |     ? data.faqs
 814 |         .map((item: any) => ({
 815 |           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
 816 |           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
 817 |         }))
 818 |         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
 819 |           item.question && item.answer
 820 |         )
 821 |     : [];
 822 |   const category = String(
 823 |     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
 824 |   ).trim();
 825 | 
 826 |   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
 827 |     "@type": "Product",
 828 |     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
 829 |     name: productName,
 830 |     url: canonicalUrl,
 831 |     description,
 832 |     brand: {
 833 |       "@type": "Brand",
 834 |       name: "FOREACH",
 835 |     },
 836 |     manufacturer: {
 837 |       "@type": "Organization",
 838 |       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
 839 |       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
 840 |     },
 841 |   };
 842 | 
 843 |   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
 844 |     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
 845 |   }
 846 | 
 847 |   if (category) {
 848 |     product.category = category;
 849 |   }
 850 | 
 851 |   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
 852 |     product.image = imageUrls;
 853 |   }
 854 | 
 855 |   if (specifications.length > 0) {
 856 |     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
 857 |       "@type": "PropertyValue",
 858 |       name: item.name,
 859 |       value: item.value,
 860 |     }));
 861 |   }
 862 | 
 863 |   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
 864 |     product,
 865 |     {
 866 |       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
 867 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
 868 |       itemListElement: [
 869 |         {
 870 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 871 |           position: 1,
 872 |           name: "Home",
 873 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
 874 |         },
 875 |         {
 876 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 877 |           position: 2,
 878 |           name: "Products",
 879 |           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
 880 |         },
 881 |         {
 882 |           "@type": "ListItem",
 883 |           position: 3,
 884 |           name: productName,
 885 |           item: canonicalUrl,
 886 |         },
 887 |       ],
 888 |     },
 889 |   ];
 890 | 
 891 |   if (faqs.length > 0) {
 892 |     graph.push({
 893 |       "@type": "FAQPage",
 894 |       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
 895 |       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
 896 |         "@type": "Question",
 897 |         name: item.question,
 898 |         acceptedAnswer: {
 899 |           "@type": "Answer",
 900 |           text: item.answer,
 901 |         },
 902 |       })),
 903 |     });
 904 |   }
 905 | 
 906 |   if (applications.length > 0) {
 907 |     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
 908 |   }
 909 | 
 910 |   return {
 911 |     "@context": "https://schema.org",
 912 |     "@graph": graph,
 913 |   };
 914 | }
```

### `app\products\[category]\[slug]\page.tsx`

```tsx
   1 | /* =========================================================
   2 |    page.tsx
   3 |    恒永达官网｜中文产品类型页 / 旧产品详情页复用动态路由
   4 | 
   5 |    文件路径：

   7 | 
   8 |    路由说明：
   9 |    1. /products/{category}/{slug}
  10 |    2. 如果 slug 命中 product-route-map.ts，则显示产品类型筛选页
  11 |       示例：/products/pumps/plunger-pumps
  12 |    3. 如果 category === "control"，则显示智控模块详情页
  13 |       示例：/products/control/abd-air-bubble-detector
  14 |    4. 如果没有命中产品类型路由，则继续按旧逻辑显示产品详情页
  15 |    5. 这样可以保留原有产品详情页，同时支持新的产品中心 SEO 路径
  16 |    6. 柱塞泵具体型号详情页已单独使用：
  17 |       /products/pumps/plunger-pumps/[slug]
  18 | ========================================================= */
  19 | 
  20 | import type { Metadata } from "next";
  21 | import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
  22 | import { Suspense } from "react";
  23 | 
  24 | import ProductPageSkeleton from "@/components/common/ProductPageSkeleton";
  25 | import ProductDetailClient from "@/components/products/detail/ProductDetailClient";

  27 |

  29 |   getProductTypeRouteParams,
  30 |   resolveProductTypeRoute,
  31 | } from "@/data/products/selection/product-route-map";
  32 | 
  33 | import {
  34 |   getAllProductDetailRouteParams,
  35 |   getProductDetailPageData,
  36 | } from "@/services/products/detail/getProductDetailPageData";
  37 | 
  38 | import {
  39 |   getControlModuleDetailBySlug,
  40 |   getControlModuleDetailSlugs,
  41 |   type ControlModuleDetail,
  42 | } from "@/data/products/control-modules/control-module-detail.generated";
  43 | 
  44 | import "../../products.css";
  45 | 
  46 | type ProductDetailRoutePageProps = {
  47 |   params: Promise<{
  48 |     category: string;
  49 |     slug: string;
  50 |   }>;
  51 | };
  52 | 
  53 | export const dynamicParams = false;
  54 | 
  55 | const CONTROL_CATEGORY_ID = "control";
  56 | 
  57 | const tubingStaticParams = [
  58 |   { category: "tubing", slug: "pvc-tubing" },
  59 |   { category: "tubing", slug: "tpu-tubing" },
  60 |   { category: "tubing", slug: "fep-tubing" },
  61 |   { category: "tubing", slug: "ptfe-tubing" },
  62 |   { category: "tubing", slug: "peek-tubing" },
  63 |   { category: "tubing", slug: "pfa-tubing" },
  64 | ];
  65 | 
  66 | /* =========================================================
  67 |    智控模块静态路由参数
  68 | 
  69 |    说明：
  70 |    1. 当前项目使用 output: export；
  71 |    2. dynamicParams = false 时，所有动态路径必须在 generateStaticParams 中列出；
  72 |    3. 所以 ABD / PDM5 详情页必须显式加入静态参数。
  73 | ========================================================= */
  74 | function getControlModuleStaticParams() {
  75 |   return getControlModuleDetailSlugs().map((slug) => ({
  76 |     category: CONTROL_CATEGORY_ID,
  77 |     slug,
  78 |   }));
  79 | }
  80 | 
  81 | /* =========================================================
  82 |    智控模块详情数据适配器
  83 | 
  84 |    说明：
  85 |    1. control-module-detail.generated.ts 是智控模块自己的数据结构；
  86 |    2. ProductDetailClient 使用的是统一详情页展示结构；
  87 |    3. 这里把智控数据转成 ProductDetailClient 可以直接渲染的字段；
  88 |    4. 不新建独立页面，不新建独立样式，继续复用公共详情页。
  89 | ========================================================= */
  90 | 
  91 | const CONTROL_MODULE_DETAIL_IMAGE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  92 |   "abd-air-bubble-detector": "/images/products/control/foreach-abd-air-bubble-detector.webp",
  93 |   "pdm5-pressure-sensor": "/images/products/control/foreach-pdm5-pressure-sensor.webp",
  94 | };
  95 | 
  96 | function getControlModuleProductDetailData(detail: ControlModuleDetail) {
  97 |   const controlModuleMainImage =
  98 |     CONTROL_MODULE_DETAIL_IMAGE_MAP[detail.slug] ||
  99 |     (detail as any).mainImage ||
 100 |     ((detail as any).images && (detail as any).images[0]) ||
 101 |     (detail as any).image ||
 102 |     "/images/logo/foreach-logo-color.svg";

 108 |   const drawing2dUrl = detail.media?.drawing2d || "";
 109 | 
 110 |   const model3dUrl = detail.media?.model3d || "";
 111 | 
 112 |   return {
 113 |     slug: detail.slug,
 114 | 
 115 |     model: detail.title,
 116 |     displayModel: detail.title,

 118 |     name: detail.title,
 119 |     title: detail.title,
 120 |

 123 |     productTypeId: "control-module",

 126 |     series: detail.categoryLabel || "智控系列",

 128 |     description: Array.isArray(detail.intro) ? detail.intro.join("\n\n") : "",
 129 |     advantages: detail.highlights || [],
 130 |     commonApplications: detail.applications || [],
 131 | 
 132 |     specs: detail.specs || [],
 133 |     faqs: detail.faqs || [],
 134 | 
 135 |     mainImage,
 136 |     imageCard: controlModuleMainImage,
 137 |     image: controlModuleMainImage,
 138 |     imagePath: controlModuleMainImage,
 139 |     imageUrl: controlModuleMainImage,
 140 |     heroImage: mainImage,
 141 |     additionalImages: [],
 142 | 
 143 |     detailHref: `/products/control/${detail.slug}`,
 144 |     href: `/products/control/${detail.slug}`,
 145 |     selectionHref: "/products",
 146 |     modelSelectionHref: "/products",
 147 |     contactHref: "/contact",
 148 | 
 149 |     primaryButtonText: "提交定制需求",
 150 |     primaryButtonHref: "/contact",
 151 |     requestHref: "/contact",
 152 | 
 153 |     showConfigurator: false,
 154 |     showDatasheetRequest: true,
 155 |     showDrawingRequest: Boolean(drawing2dUrl),
 156 |     show3DRequest: Boolean(model3dUrl),
 157 | 
 158 |     drawing2dUrl,
 159 |     drawingPdfUrl: drawing2dUrl,
 160 |     partDrawingUrl: drawing2dUrl,
 161 |     model3dUrl,
 162 | 
 163 |     resources: {
 164 |       drawing2dUrl,
 165 |       model3dUrl,
 166 |     },
 167 |   } as any;
 168 | }
 169 | 
 170 | export function generateStaticParams() {
 171 |   const detailParams = getAllProductDetailRouteParams();
 172 | 
 173 |   const productTypeParams = getProductTypeRouteParams();
 174 | 
 175 |   const controlModuleParams = getControlModuleStaticParams();
 176 | 
 177 |   return [
 178 |     ...productTypeParams,
 179 |     ...detailParams,
 180 |     ...controlModuleParams,
 181 |     ...tubingStaticParams,
 182 |   ];
 183 | }
 184 | 
 185 | export async function generateMetadata({
 186 |   params,
 187 | }: ProductDetailRoutePageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
 188 |   const { category, slug } = await params;
 189 | 
 190 |   const productTypeRoute = resolveProductTypeRoute(category, slug);
 191 | 
 192 |   if (productTypeRoute) {
 193 |     return {
 194 |       title: productTypeRoute.title,
 195 |       description: productTypeRoute.description,
 196 |     };
 197 |   }
 198 | 
 199 |   if (category === CONTROL_CATEGORY_ID) {
 200 |     const detail = getControlModuleDetailBySlug(slug);
 201 | 
 202 |     if (!detail) {
 203 |       return {};
 204 |     }
 205 | 
 206 |     return {
 207 |       title: `${detail.title} | FOREACH`,
 208 |       description: Array.isArray(detail.intro)
 209 |         ? detail.intro.join(" ").slice(0, 160)
 210 |         : detail.title,
 211 |     };
 212 |   }
 213 | 
 214 |   const pageData = getProductDetailPageData({
 215 |     category,
 216 |     slug,
 217 |   });
 218 | 
 219 |   if (!pageData) {
 220 |     return {};
 221 |   }
 222 | 
 223 |   return {
 224 |     title: `${slug} | FOREACH`,
 225 |   };
 226 | }
 227 | 
 228 | export default async function ProductDetailRoutePage({
 229 |   params,
 230 | }: ProductDetailRoutePageProps) {
 231 |   const { category, slug } = await params;
 232 | 
 233 |   const productTypeRoute = resolveProductTypeRoute(category, slug);
 234 | 
 235 |   if (productTypeRoute) {
 236 |     return (
 237 |       <Suspense fallback={<ProductPageSkeleton variant="selection" />}>
 238 |         <ProductSelectionClient
 239 |           locale="zh"
 240 |           initialCategoryId={productTypeRoute.categoryId}
 241 |           initialProductTypeId={productTypeRoute.productTypeId}
 242 |         />
 243 |       </Suspense>
 244 |     );
 245 |   }
 246 | 
 247 |   if (category === CONTROL_CATEGORY_ID) {
 248 |     const controlDetail = getControlModuleDetailBySlug(slug);
 249 | 
 250 |     if (!controlDetail) {
 251 |       notFound();
 252 |     }
 253 | 
 254 |     return (
 255 |       <ProductDetailClient
 256 |         data={getControlModuleProductDetailData(controlDetail)}
 257 |       />
 258 |     );
 259 |   }
 260 | 
 261 |   const pageData = getProductDetailPageData({
 262 |     category,
 263 |     slug,
 264 |   });
 265 | 
 266 |   if (!pageData) {
 267 |     notFound();
 268 |   }
 269 | 
 270 |   return <ProductDetailClient data={pageData} />;
 271 | }
```

```tsx
  91 | function getText(value: unknown) {
  92 |   return String(value || "").trim();
  93 | }
  94 | 
  95 | function normalizeSlug(value: unknown) {
  96 |   const parts = getText(value).split("/").filter(Boolean);
  97 |   return parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : "";
  98 | }
  99 | 
 100 | function findDetail(slug: string) {
 101 |   const targetSlug = normalizeSlug(slug);
 102 | 
 103 |   return details.find((item) => {
 104 |     return normalizeSlug(item.slug) === targetSlug;
 105 |   });

 107 | 
 108 | function publicSrcFromFullPath(fullPath?: string) {
 109 |   const value = String(fullPath || "").replaceAll("\\", "/");
 110 | 
 111 |   if (!value) return "";
 112 | 
 113 |   if (value.startsWith("public/")) {
 114 |     return "/" + value.slice("public/".length);
 115 |   }
 116 | 
 117 |   if (value.startsWith("/public/")) {
 118 |     return value.replace(/^\/public\//, "/");
 119 |   }
 120 | 
 121 |   return value.startsWith("/") ? value : "/" + value;
 122 | }
 123 | 
 124 | function shouldUseMedia(media?: DiaphragmMedia) {
 125 |   const status = getText(media?.status);
 126 | 
 127 |   if (!media?.fullPath) return false;
 128 | 
 129 |   /*
 130 |    * 不使用 fs.existsSync，避免 Turbopack 全项目扫描。
 131 |    * 如果资源索引里明确写了“待 / 缺失 / MISS / 未放置”，前台先不输出，避免破图。
 132 |    * 后续真实资源放好后，只需要把资源索引状态改成可用，或清空这些负向状态。
 133 |    */
 134 |   if (/待|缺失|MISS|未放置|missing/i.test(status)) {
 135 |     return false;
 136 |   }
 137 | 
 138 |   return true;
 139 | }
 140 | 
 141 | function findMediaByType(detail: DiaphragmDetail, keyword: string) {
 142 |   return (detail.media || []).find((item) => {
 143 |     return getText(item.resourceType).includes(keyword);
 144 |   });
 145 | }
 146 | 
 147 | function findMediaUrlByType(detail: DiaphragmDetail, keyword: string) {
 148 |   const media = findMediaByType(detail, keyword);
 149 | 
 150 |   if (!shouldUseMedia(media)) {
 151 |     return "";
 152 |   }
 153 | 
 154 |   return publicSrcFromFullPath(media?.fullPath);
 155 | }
 156 | 
 157 | function splitApplications(value?: string) {
 158 |   return String(value || "")
 159 |     .split(/[、,，]/)
 160 |     .map((item) => item.trim())
 161 |     .filter(Boolean);
 162 | }
 163 | 
 164 | function normalizeSpecifications(detail: DiaphragmDetail) {
 165 |   return (detail.specifications || [])
 166 |     .map((item) => {
 167 |       const label = getText(item.parameter);
 168 |       const value = getText(item.value);
 169 |       const note = getText(item.note);
 170 | 
 171 |       return {
 172 |         label,
 173 |         name: label,
 174 |         title: label,
 175 |         value,
 176 |         content: value,
 177 |         note,
 178 |         remark: note,
 179 |       };
 180 |     })
 181 |     .filter((item) => item.label && item.value);
 182 | }
 183 | 
 184 | 
 185 | function normalizeSpecGroupTitle(value: unknown) {
 186 |   const title = getText(value);
 187 | 
 188 |   /*
 189 |    * ProductDetailClient 外层已经显示“规格参数”。
 190 |    * 如果数据分组标题也叫“规格参数”，页面会出现重复标题。
 191 |    * 这里仅针对隔膜泵详情页做显示层归一，不改原始参数数据。
 192 |    */
 193 |   if (!title || title === "规格参数") {
 194 |     return "技术参数";
 195 |   }
 196 | 
 197 |   return title;
 198 | }
 199 | 
 200 | 
 201 | function dedupeSpecifications<T extends { label?: string; name?: string; title?: string; value?: string; content?: string; note?: string; remark?: string }>(items: T[]) {
 202 |   const seen = new Set<string>();
 203 | 
 204 |   return items.filter((item) => {
 205 |     const key = [
 206 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || "",
 207 |       item.value || item.content || "",
 208 |       item.note || item.remark || "",
 209 |     ]
 210 |       .map((value) => String(value).trim())
 211 |       .join("||");
 212 | 
 213 |     if (!key.replace(/\|/g, "")) {
 214 |       return false;
 215 |     }
 216 | 
 217 |     if (seen.has(key)) {
 218 |       return false;
 219 |     }
 220 | 
 221 |     seen.add(key);
 222 |     return true;
 223 |   });
 224 | }
 225 | 
 226 | function groupSpecifications(detail: DiaphragmDetail) {
 227 |   const map = new Map<string, DiaphragmSpec[]>();
 228 | 
 229 |   (detail.specifications || []).forEach((item) => {
 230 |     const key = normalizeSpecGroupTitle(item.tableName);
 231 |     const rows = map.get(key) || [];
 232 |     rows.push(item);
 233 |     map.set(key, rows);
 234 |   });
 235 | 
 236 |   const groups = Array.from(map.entries()).map(([title, rows]) => ({
 237 |     title,
 238 |     items: rows
 239 |       .map((item) => {
 240 |         const label = getText(item.parameter);
 241 |         const value = getText(item.value);
 242 |         const note = getText(item.note);
 243 | 
 244 |         return {
 245 |           label,
 246 |           name: label,
 247 |           title: label,
 248 |           value,
 249 |           content: value,
 250 |           note,
 251 |           remark: note,
 252 |         };
 253 |       })
 254 |       .filter((item) => item.label && item.value),
 255 |   }));
 256 | 
 257 |   return groups.filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
 258 | }
 259 | 
 260 | function normalizeFaqs(detail: DiaphragmDetail) {
 261 |   return (detail.faqs || [])
 262 |     .map((item) => ({
 263 |       question: getText(item.question),
 264 |       answer: getText(item.answer),
 265 |     }))
 266 |     .filter((item) => item.question && item.answer);
 267 | }
 268 | 
 269 | function normalizeModelConfigurations(detail: DiaphragmDetail) {
 270 |   return (detail.modelConfigurations || []).map((item) => ({
 271 |     itemCode: getText(item.itemCode),
 272 |     model: getText(item.model),
 273 |     category: getText(item.category),
 274 |     motorType: getText(item.motorType),
 275 |     voltage: getText(item.voltage),
 276 |     connectionType: getText(item.connectionType),
 277 |     portDirection: getText(item.portDirection),
 278 |     diaphragm: getText(item.diaphragm),
 279 |     valvePlate: getText(item.valvePlate),
 280 |     pumpHead: getText(item.pumpHead),

 308 | function toPublicAssetHref(value: unknown) {

 315 |   }

 347 | function getCleanDiaphragmModelCode(detail: DiaphragmDetail) {
 348 |   const text = [
 349 |     detail.modelDisplay,
 350 |     detail.modelConfigurations?.[0]?.model,

 352 |     detail.displayName,

 354 |     detail.slug,
 355 |   ]
 356 |     .map(getText)

 362 | 
 363 |   if (directMatch) {
 364 |     return [
 365 |       directMatch[1],
 366 |       directMatch[2],
 367 |       directMatch[3] + "/" + directMatch[4],
 368 |     ].join("-").toUpperCase();
 369 |   }
 370 | 
 371 |   const slugText = getText(detail.slug).toUpperCase();
 372 |   const slugMatch = slugText.match(/\b(DPL\d+H?|DPGL\d+)-([A-Z0-9]+)-([A-Z]{2})-([A-Z]{2})\b/i);
 373 | 
 374 |   if (slugMatch) {
 375 |     return [

 377 |       slugMatch[2],
 378 |       slugMatch[3] + "/" + slugMatch[4],
 379 |     ].join("-").toUpperCase();
 380 |   }
 381 | 
 382 |   return getText(detail.modelDisplay || detail.title || detail.displayName)
 383 |     .replace(/\s*(高压液体隔膜泵|气液混合隔膜泵|液体隔膜泵|隔膜泵).*$/g, "")
 384 |     .trim();
```

```tsx
 317 | function getCapacityFileCodeCandidates(seriesUpper: string, capacity: string) {
 318 |   const capacityText = getText(capacity).toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "");
 319 |   const numberText = capacityText.match(/\d+(\.\d+)?/)?.[0] || "";
 320 |   const value = Number(numberText);

 323 |     return [];
 324 |   }
 325 | 
 326 |   if (capacityText.includes("ml")) {
 327 |     const ulCode = String(Math.round(value * 1000)).padStart(4, "0") + "UL";
 328 |     const mlCode = String(Math.round(value)).padStart(4, "0") + "ML";
 329 | 
 330 |     return [
 331 |       seriesUpper + "-" + ulCode,
 332 |       seriesUpper + "-" + mlCode,
 333 |     ];
 334 |   }
 335 | 
 336 |   const ulCode = String(Math.round(value)).padStart(4, "0") + "UL";
 337 | 
 338 |   return [
 339 |     seriesUpper + "-" + ulCode,
 340 |   ];
 341 | }

 366 |         "/" +
 367 |         folderName +
```

```tsx
 102 | function getProductDrawingPreviewUrl(slug: string, configuredUrl?: string) {
 103 |   const normalizedConfiguredUrl = configuredUrl?.trim();
 104 | 
 105 |   if (normalizedConfiguredUrl) {
 106 |     return normalizedConfiguredUrl.includes("#")
 107 |       ? normalizedConfiguredUrl
 108 |       : normalizedConfiguredUrl + "#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1";
 109 |   }
 110 | 
 111 |   const normalizedSlug = slug.trim().toLowerCase();
 112 |   const match = normalizedSlug.match(/^(ea|sm|tm)-(\d+)/);
 113 | 
 114 |   if (!match) {
 115 |     return "";
 116 |   }
 117 | 
 118 |   const seriesCode = match[1];
 119 |   const seriesUpper = seriesCode.toUpperCase();
 120 |   const capacityCode = String(Number(match[2])).padStart(4, "0") + "UL";
 121 | 
 122 |   return (
 123 |     "/assets/products/" +
 124 |     seriesCode +
 125 |     "/2d-drawings/" +
 126 |     seriesUpper +
 127 |     "-" +
 128 |     capacityCode +
 129 |     ".pdf#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1"
 130 |   );
 131 | }

 135 |

 137 | }
```
