 252 | function isFittingDetailData(data: any): boolean {
 253 |   const categoryText = [
 254 |     data?.sourceType,
 255 |     data?.productCategory,
 256 |     data?.productType,
 257 |     data?.productTypeId,
 258 |     data?.productTypeName,
 259 |     data?.category,
 260 |     data?.categoryId,
 261 |     data?.categoryKey,
 262 |     data?.series,
 263 |     data?.seriesName,
 264 |     data?.detailMode,
 265 |     data?.slug,
 266 |     data?.href,
 267 |     data?.detailHref,
 268 |   ]
 269 |     .map((value) =>
 270 |       String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase()
 271 |     )
 272 |     .filter(Boolean)
 273 |     .join(" ");
 274 | 
 275 |   const model = String(
 276 |     data?.model ||
 277 |       data?.displayModel ||
 278 |       data?.modelDisplay ||
 279 |       data?.foreachModel ||
 280 |       ""
 281 |   )
 282 |     .trim()
 283 |     .toUpperCase();
 284 | 
 285 |   return (
 286 |     categoryText.includes("fitting") ||
 287 |     categoryText.includes("connector") ||
 288 |     categoryText.includes("quick-connect") ||
 289 |     categoryText.includes("hard-tube") ||
 290 |     categoryText.includes("luer") ||
 291 |     categoryText.includes("barbed") ||
 292 |     categoryText.includes("thread-to-barbed") ||
 293 |     categoryText.includes("female-thread-adapter") ||
 294 |     categoryText.includes("bulkhead-barbed") ||
 295 |     categoryText.includes("check-valve") ||
 296 |     categoryText.includes("filter") ||
 297 |     /^(Q20|Q40|Q60)/.test(model)
 298 |   );
 299 | }

 302 | function getDisplayModelText(data: any): string {
 303 |   if (isTubingDetailData(data)) {
 304 |     return "XXX-XXX-XX-XX";
 305 |   }
 306 | 
 307 |   if (isHardTubeTargetLocale(String(data?.__locale || ""))) {
 308 |     return data?.displayModel || data?.model || "";
 309 |   }

 312 |     return data?.__locale === "en"
 313 |       ? "Contact us for a custom configuration"
 314 |       : "定制配置请联系我们";
 315 |   }
 316 |

 320 | function isCustomInquiryMode(data: any): boolean {
 321 | 
 322 |   if (
 323 |     isValvelessPumpDetailData(data) ||
 324 |     data?.isCustomOnly === true ||
 325 |     data?.showCustomInquiryCta === true
 326 |   ) {
 327 |     return true;
 328 |   }
 329 | const detailMode = String(
 330 |     data?.detailMode ||
 331 |       data?.hero?.detailMode ||
 332 |       data?.productMode ||
 333 |       data?.mode ||
 334 |       ""
 335 |   ).trim();
 336 | 
 337 |   if (
 338 |     detailMode === "custom_inquiry" ||
 339 |     detailMode === "custom" ||
 340 |     detailMode === "customized"
 341 |   ) {
 342 |     return true;
 343 |   }
 344 | 
 345 |   if (
 346 |     detailMode === "standard_model" ||
 347 |     detailMode === "standard" ||
 348 |     detailMode === "selection" ||
 349 |     detailMode === "configurable"
 350 |   ) {
 351 |     return false;
 352 |   }
 353 | 
 354 |   if (data?.isCustomInquiry === true) {
 355 |     return true;
 356 |   }
 357 | 
 358 |   if (data?.showConfigurator === true || data?.hasConfigurator === true) {
 359 |     return false;
 360 |   }
 361 | 
 362 |   const displayModel = data?.displayModel || data?.model || "";
 363 | 
 364 |   return isPlungerPumpDisplayModel(displayModel);
 365 | }

 885 | function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
 886 |   const values: unknown[] = [
 887 |     data.mainImage,
 888 |     data.imageUrl,
 889 |     data.image,
 890 |     data.heroImage,
 891 |     data.coverImage,
 892 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
 893 |     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
 894 |   ];
 895 | 
 896 |   const urls = values
 897 |     .flatMap((value) => {
 898 |       if (typeof value === "string") {
 899 |         return [value];
 900 |       }
 901 | 
 902 |       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 903 |         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 904 |         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
 905 |       }
 906 | 
 907 |       return [];
 908 |     })
 909 |     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
 910 |     .filter(Boolean);
 911 | 
 912 |   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
 913 | }

 915 | function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
 916 |   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
 917 |     ? data.specs
 918 |     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
 919 |       ? data.specificationGroups
 920 |       : [];
 921 |   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
 922 | 
 923 |   function visit(value: unknown) {
 924 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 925 |       value.forEach(visit);
 926 |       return;
 927 |     }
 928 | 
 929 |     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
 930 |       return;
 931 |     }
 932 | 
 933 |     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 934 |     const name = String(
 935 |       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
 936 |     ).trim();
 937 |     const itemValue = String(
 938 |       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
 939 |     ).trim();
 940 | 
 941 |     if (name && itemValue) {
 942 |       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
 943 |     }
 944 | 
 945 |     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
 946 |       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
 947 |         visit(child);
 948 |       }
 949 |     });
 950 |   }
 951 | 
 952 |   visit(source);
 953 | 
 954 |   return Array.from(
 955 |     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
 956 |   );
 957 | }

   1 | const fs = require("fs");

   6 |    恒永达官网｜产品中心卡片文案与详情页长文分离检查
   7 | 
   8 |    作用：

  10 |    2. 检查产品中心组件是否误用详情页 advantages

  12 |    4. 检查产品中心生成数据里是否出现明显详情页长文
  13 |    5. 只读取文件，不修改任何文件
  14 | 
  15 |    使用方式：
  16 |    node scripts/products/check-selection-detail-copy-separation.js
  17 | ========================================================= */
  18 |

  20 |

  33 |     "detail",

  53 |     "products",
  54 |     "detail",

  56 |   ),

  59 |     "data",
  60 |     "products",
  61 |     "selection",
  62 |     "product-selection.generated.ts"
  63 |   ),
  64 | };
  65 |

  68 |     return "";
  69 |   }
  70 | 
  71 |   return fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  72 | }
  73 | 
  74 | function reportError(message) {

  76 | }
  77 | 
  78 | function reportOk(message) {

  80 | }

## 九、下一步检查重点

1. CTA 蓝色模块外层是否同时存在 `padding-bottom` 和下一模块的 `padding-top`。
2. CTA 后面是否存在空的 `div`、`section`、分隔线或占位容器。
3. 是否存在 `border-bottom`、`after:`、`::after` 等装饰层。
4. 下一模块是否设置了固定高度、最小高度或浅灰色背景。
5. 页面公共容器是否统一添加了上下间距。
